title: KAITO — Card Story

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hi, everyone.
My name is KAITO. Nice to meet you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow! Thanks for that rousing welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I heard some of you here have never met us before. I'm glad you seem to be enjoying yourselves still!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, maybe I should do a quick introduction of myself before we start.
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm... I see...
A simple self-introduction like this can be effective too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The main part is the song that comes later, in which case, it would be best to keep the introduction simple...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wooonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Naaargh?! You again, Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Stop suddenly jumping out from behind like that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe, did it make your heart go badump-badump?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It badumped so hard I almost dumped my smartphone onto the floor...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey!
You're watching a VIRTUAL SINGER live show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Do you ever listen to what anyone says?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh. Never mind. You should watch and learn too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Learn what?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Just watch and you'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well? Understand now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The stage isn't particularly gorgeous, and they're wearing their usual outfits.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yet, you can really feel their presence!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is it the stage effects?
Or because they're just that good? Doesn't it make you wonder?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm... Speaking of things that make me wonder...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Did you discover something useful from the video too? Go on, share it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Why does KAITO wear a scarf?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh...
I was a fool to believe it would be anything good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: KAITO's been around for a while, and now you wonder?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, but MEIKO's clothes look so cooling, right? Yet KAITO wears a scarf and a coat...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gasp! Is he like...super afraid of the cold?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGERS don't feel cold...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The scarf's something like KAITO's trademark anyway. It's normal for him to be seen in it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Trademark?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know! Just like it's normal for pandas to have black eyes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Pandas are born with black eyes, though?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks, KAITO!
I had a great time singing with you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too! It's been a while since we sang together like this. It was a pleasure indeed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shall we call everyone back out to the stage?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's all come together to make things livelier than before!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shall we call everyone back out to the stage?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's all come together to make things livelier than before!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: We're here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah! Rin and Len?!
You're supposed to come out later...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you just said, let's all come together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: First to appear gets to go first!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Let the music begin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Wait... Whaaat?!
Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hi, you're here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Were you lying in wait for me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After all, we're going to be Phoenix Wonderland colleagues from today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You don't know where the staff entrance is, right? I thought you might need a guide.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, have you seen this video yet, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's a video of KAITO performing at an event.
They've made part of the show available for a limited time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No! I still wanna sing with KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I haven't had enough, yet, either!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
C-Come on, you two...
I'm sure we'll have plenty of chances to sing together again next time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't know you were interested in VIRTUAL SINGERS...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
They're cutting-edge technology.
Of course I'm interested.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm also interested in their singing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Has it ever occurred to you that their singing voices are quite compatible with narrative songs?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Narrative songs?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A song with an unfolding story and specific characters. Does that make it easier to understand?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The songs featured in musicals are something like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think VIRTUAL SINGERS would excel at singing such songs.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A human voice would be affected by the singer's mood, techniques, and frame of mind, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With VIRTUAL SINGERS, there are no such considerations.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It falls squarely on the director to use them to draw out the best part of a song's characteristics and appeal.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actors capable of moving exactly the way the director wants like that are few and far between, you see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you meant that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Phew... Sorry about the ruckus Rin and Len caused.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Once again...
Please enjoy the next song!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From a cheerful pop rock song to an alluring ballad...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You need great flexibility to pull off this disconnect well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's a lot of equipment to prepare for a show like this. It may not be possible to do in Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if the opportunity arises, I would love to perform together.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He's usually hanging out around this stage... Ah, I see him!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello, Tsukasa.
Are your friends not coming today?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's just me this time.
I come to seek your wisdom, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay? What would you like to know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You seem to be the leader of your troupe.
Can you tell me how you manage to put shows together?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In what way?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I want to learn your secret for getting an unruly troupe of weird actors under control so that you can stage great productions.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For me, it's a constant struggle to rein in my team so that they don't ruin everything with their crazy ideas.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My ambition to become the world's top star is at stake!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem... So, anyway.
I'd like some advice on how to act as a leader.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What you're asking is...how I manage to stage shows with Miku and the plushies as my actors?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly. Do you bribe them with candy to get them to listen to you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Or are you able to predict what trouble they're going to cause and stop them in time?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, no, I don't do anything like that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then what's your secret?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The other day we did a show including some magic tricks...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You will now witness my miraculous escape!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku is going to pierce this box with swords, while I'm trapped inside! Miku, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Suuure thing♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It's stabby-stabby time☆
The first sword's goooing in!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aaand another! Aaand a third!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And now some more!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: W-Wait! Miku, I asked you to use only three swords, remember?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course I do! But we've got five swords here. Wouldn't it be a shame not to use them all?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That wasn't in the plan!!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Without further ado, here we go~☆
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Holy cow, that's terrifying!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Luckily, it turns out I'm more flexible than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can you just laugh it off...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku's improvisation proved very popular with the audience and we got a huge applause.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course it's best when everybody in the troupe shares the same vision, but accidents happen, and isn't it our job as showmen to deal with that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why it never occurred to me to try to exert control over my troupe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My role is to enable them to put on the most exciting shows they can think of.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I guess that's our lot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But doesn't that mean I just have to put up with the insane antics of my crazy team?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's a trade-off.
It's more difficult for you, but makes for more fun, exciting shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're right, can't disagree with that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You know what each member's forte is, and how to bring it to the forefront. You're going to make an exceptional leader.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I am the world's top star-to-be after all!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, we're getting there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Greetings, KAITO.
I hope I'm not interrupting anything?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hello, Rui.
You came here on your own this time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Is that surprising?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, it seems to be the new trend...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nevermind.
You're always welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm in the middle of tidying up the stage.
I'm sorry I can't give you my full attention at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you like me to help?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you don't mind?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll be happy to lend you a hand, if we could chat a little about this SEKAI while we're at it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This world is one big mystery, and I'm very curious about it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sure, we can talk while getting this place in order.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: First, we need to roll call the puppets and plushies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Roll call?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This is to check that one's gone missing.
You do it like this... Puppets, line up!

rows.Speaker: Puppets
rows.Line: Here♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, it's certainly helpful when your props can line up when called to account for everything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It makes it much easier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Could you call out numbers and check if we've got everyone? I'll count the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure, you can leave this to me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Plushies, line up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, we got everyone.
Thank you for your hard work, plushies and puppets! See you at the next show!

rows.Speaker: Puppets
rows.Line: Okay♪ See you next time♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So you just let them go?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. They can roam freely in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You have quite the variety of plushies and puppets. Some are cute, some have a cool look. They also come in all colors and sizes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What criteria do you use to choose the right ones for your shows?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't. I enroll the ones who volunteer to help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As you know, this world is created from strong feelings. They shaped each of the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean Tsukasa's feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes. And it's not only the plushies.
Everything here reflects something in Tsukasa's psyche.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's probably why instead of a human audience, we have toys and animals watching our shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think that it's because when Tsukasa was little, he used to play theater in front of his toys.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If that's so, then do you suppose the wild variety of genres of your shows is also to do with Tsukasa's experiences?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I would think so.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why don't you ask Tsukasa about it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Getting to know him better is the key to understanding this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... We're not really the sort of close friends who'd discuss each other's childhood memories.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's always fixated on the latest show we're working on and that's all we talk about.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On the other hand, he's the only person who can offer the most valuable insight into this world... So I might try to have a more personal chat with him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You definitely should.
It makes me happy that you have an interest in our SEKAI.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa finally came to SEKAI, but we didn't get a chance to do a show together with him...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was so sure he would find his true feelings if we just did a show together...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that was unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then, how about we start making preparations now for doing a show together with him the next time he drops by?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's true!
We should do that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're so clever, KAITO♪
Let's prepare for our next show with him!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what kind of show Tsukasa wants to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, he said he wanted to be a star, so maybe something glamorous and florid?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Glamorous and florid... Florid... Flo...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I get it! Flowers!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are singing flowers everywhere around, right? Why don't we do a show together with them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm gonna go ask them about this! KAITO, go ask around too and see if there's anyone else willing to take part in the show with us☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, wait, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyone else who may be willing to take part in the show with us, huh? In that case...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And that's why I'm here.
Would all of you like to take part in our next show together?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: I wanna be in a show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Okay, this way to the stage...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: *waddle waddle*

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: *toddle toddle*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh dear... It's going to take quite a while for us to reach the stage at this rate. Here, I'll carry you guys.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Up you go!
Alright, to the stage we g—

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: What're you guys doing?

rows.Speaker: Plushie D
rows.Line: Is this a game?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, you two. Would you like to be in the show too?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good! Then grab my arm and...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm happy so many of you want to join the show, but... You guys are really starting to get heavy...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The stage is just ahead, though. I can do this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh?
Did everybody suddenly get lighter?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Bubbles!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: I see bubbles too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hey, wait!
Where's everyone going?!

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: I'm gonna blow the bubbles away!

rows.Speaker: Plushie D
rows.Line: So am I!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Bubbles? Where are they coming from?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO!
Look at how pretty this is♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku! Where did you get those bubbles from?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
The flowers told me about them!
The bubbles were on the ground over there, so I sent them flying here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's use flying bubbles in our show too!
Maybe Tsukasa will join us because of how sparkly they are!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope our sparkly show can help Tsukasa to find his true feelings!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I hope so too, Miku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Can I help you move the bubbles?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't see why not☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay then. Here goes! Huff!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wow! So pretty!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A smile on everyone's face is the best kind of happiness.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Everybody! The show is about to begin!
...Oh, who's this?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hellooo♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hello...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome, welcome, Emu and Nene!
Our show is just about to begin. Would you like to stay and watch?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can we?! I wanna see, I wanna see♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, me too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Both of you are here by yourselves today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All four of us came together, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heeey♪ Come join us in our show later☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're as random as always, but if you're saying that you need my star abilities, then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe... It is a request I cannot turn down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yaaay☆ Okay, Tsukasa can play the role of the character who makes his entrance by jumping off a flying train♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I'll make my entrance by jumping off a flying train... Are you trying to kill me?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, why would I?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Says the person who wants me to jump off a flying train!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, wait. There has to be a good way to do this, Tsukasa! Let's think this through together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you're just hoping to get a kick out of this! Absolutely not!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh dear, he ran away.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hahaha☆
Wait for meee♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And then they all ran off somewhere together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so nice! I wanted to play chase with them too! I can't believe they just vanished while I was talking with the flowers.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sorry. Miku must have been really excited because it's been a while since everyone visited.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's go to the stage, we can probably find everyone there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
Every time I come to this SEKAI, I can't help but wonder...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This place is made from Tsukasa's feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I would have expected a place like that to have a loud and conspicuous self-proclaimed star who's just like him...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone here takes part in shows, but nobody tries to claim to be a star the way he does. I wonder why?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It must be because everyone in this SEKAI is a star♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Everyone is a star?
How does that work?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Remember how he was like before?
Back then, it felt like he always wanted to be the one to stand out the most.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well...
I would say that Emu's thinking is actually quite accurate.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure that somewhere deep inside, Tsukasa always knew a lone star couldn't shine brightly or do a show by himself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A good show is the product of many people who work hard to fill different roles.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each one of them has to shine in their given positions.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A real star can only shine brightly when his companions do the same with a smile. He must have felt that somehow.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really doubt anything like that goes through his mind...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
Tsukasa's already at the stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You guys sure took your time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The rehearsal for my entrance scene starring me, by me, and for me shall now begin! Play along, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I hope you can jump off the train successfully.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: KAITO... Don't you think you're giving him too much credit than he deserves?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, maybe!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm, they're not on the stage either.
Where else have I not looked?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? Is something wrong, KAITO?
Today's show won't be starting for a while yet, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, Miku. Actually, you came at just the right time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Have you seen a doggie and kitty plushie anywhere around?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You mean the plushies who had a fight with each other just the other day?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, I'm looking for a different pair right now.
But I guess you could say this pair was having a bit of trouble too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With everything that was going on with Tsukasa and Rui, it didn't feel right to leave them be, so I asked them what had happened, and...
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Phew. That was a good show we put on today.
Now, to prepare for tomorrow's show... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Ugh... Sniff...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: I told you, it's pointless to cry!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Did you get into a fight again?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line:
We're not fighting!
It's just that kitty's being indecisive again!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: What're you sorry for?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright, calm down.
Can you tell me what happened?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: There's nothing to tell!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Kitty, you're always like this when we get together to discuss the show!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: It's obvious you're thinking hard about something, but in the end, you never tell us what it is!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: If you have something to say, just say it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see now... Then all the more we should try to find out what's on kitty's mind, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Doggie, I know you have a lot of things to say, but could I trouble you to control yourself for a short while?

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Fine...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's alright.
Doggie and I will listen to you without interrupting.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So, go on, tell us what's on your mind.
What do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Sniff... But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't worry. Just tell us.

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: I...I want to be friends with everyone too...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: I told you—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, now, you promised to control yourself, didn't you? Let kitty finish.

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Kitty, please continue.

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: I want to be friends, but I'm worried that I'll say something weird and end up being an outcast... That would hurt me more than being alone...

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: That's why I...I just can't bring myself to speak my mind...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah... You're afraid of being alone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you shouldn't worry, because you already have a friend right here, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: I do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Doggie's always trying to get you to speak up because it wants to know what's on your mind. This means that doggie is concerned about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That also means that it wants to get to know you better, don't you agree?

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Get to know me better?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. So now all that's left for you to do is to pluck up the courage to speak.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, that was very nice of them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. At that time, I felt like Rui's solitude was somewhat connected to the kitty plushie.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why I wanted kitty to realize that it had a friend who was concerned about it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are those the plushies you were looking for?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh! Yes, that's them right there.
Looks like they're talking about something.

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: This is the scene where I take down the demon lord! I want to look super cool doing it!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Um, then... Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Take your time to come up with something good. I've recently learned how to wait!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think things are fine between them now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yups♪ And that's awesome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A place where you can put on the show of your life, along with friends who will support that, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope it's going well between Rui and his friends too.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What? You're leaving already?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yeah. We practiced quite a lot, after all!
And we have to prepare for tomorrow's show, too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although the Halloween show is over, we still have our regular stage performances to tend to.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Tsukasa, what's your opinion about going around the world? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't like where this is going, but...tell me more.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, that sounds cool! Tell me more too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Looks like both Rui and Tsukasa are back to their usual selves now. That's great.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO, I'm back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome back. I saw that you were having a lot of fun with Rui and Tsukasa, hm?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe, they promised to perform together with me the next time they're here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's fantastic. I look forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, I was thinking of asking Rin to join us in the performance too, but does Tsukasa know that Rin is already in this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I introduced her to them before, and they even did a show together too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I haven't been seeing her around much lately. But I'm sure she's just found somewhere to play by herself in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup. Probably playing on an attraction somewhere today too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whenever we do meet, she's full of stories to tell about the attractions she's played and plushies she's met!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why I want to tell her about the shows that I've been doing with you and everyone else too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I'm glad to hear she's keeping well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the way, while I'm inviting her to join this next show, can I invite her to your theatrical troupe too, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: She's really interested in performances and such, so I'm sure she'd jump at the chance to join!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course. We would love to have her.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yay! Okay, I'll invite her the next time we meet, then!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Aww, Len's so happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He must've been itching to perform together with Rin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup♪ I can't wait to see them perform together too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Besides, I know you want to see Tsukasa and Rui's show too, now that they've made up with each other, right, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm really so glad to see that Rui has recovered from feeling down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I bet it was because Tsukasa tried his bestest to help♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I bet it was!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By thus supporting your friends in what they want to do, and putting smiles on their faces...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, and Rui are certainly starting to grow and mature together as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! You can't make lots of people smile if you don't make yourself smile first☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our smile makes our friends smile, which leads to the smiles of the people watching our shows, and their smiles will, in turn, make us smile as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope we can become a troupe that connects the smiles of many people together like that as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? What're you talking about, KAITO?
We already are a troupe that connects smiles together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Every day, we perform happily together on stage, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And when Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, and Rui come to watch or join us in our shows, they're always smiling too, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And then when we see them smile, the plushies and myself will break out into huge grins too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See? A neverending loop of smiles♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha, you're absolutely right.
Thank you, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then! We'll have to keep this momentum going, and continue making great shows together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So that this loop of smiles never stops going!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, let's do our best! Whoo!
Two months before the School Festival
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Good job, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And good job today, Len, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks! But I feel like I could've kept going.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too!
It's so fun to rehearse with you♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, Tsukasa.
When will I see you next?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I'm not sure any of us will be able to drop in for a while.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be busy preparing for our School Festival.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A School Festival? Is that when students run pop-up food stalls and organize various events?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's exactly right! In case you were wondering, my class is doing a theatrical performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe! Even for the festival,
Tsukasa's gonna be on stage♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's good for you, Tsukasa.
What's your play about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that's a secret! But I can tell you that it's going to be a masterpiece because I wrote the script AND am the lead actor!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm surprised your classmates were okay with that. A play's a lot of work, so most people try to avoid doing one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh. They tried to shoot me down at first, but when I showed them the script, they unanimously approved it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Somehow, I find that hard to believe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it is the truth! This play is so exquisite, it moves people to tears. You should be looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... A School Festival... And a play, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh? Are you interested, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course I'd like to see a show if my friends are in it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd even like to see the whole process from the beginning, rehearsals and even the actual show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, you can! And having you there will be good for us since you can offer us pointers and whatnot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, you won't mind?
In that case, I'll gladly come and help!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aww, I'm so jealous!
I want to see your rehearsals too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Didn't you say that couldn't come to the School Festival because you're doing something with your family that day?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah... But I really, really want to go...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... Hey, chin up! I'll perform some of the best parts of the play just for you at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You will?! Yaaay!
I can't wait to see it♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing your rehearsals.
A few days later
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, we're in the clear. People are too busy preparing everything right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm sorry for inconveniencing you like this, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're not. I owe you more than this for your kind guidance and advice. Besides, I'm curious about Tsukasa's play myself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And this is his classroom.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Sweet Juliet! I will free you from the confines of your prison!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It sounds like the rehearsal had already begun.>
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate A
rows.Line: Not so fast! It shall be me who takes Juliet's hand in marriage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate B
rows.Line:
Nonsense! I'm the one and only real Romeo!
I refuse to lose Juliet to an impostor!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's this?! You're all also Romeo?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <There are quite a lot of Romeos in this play...>

rows.Speaker: Rui's Voice
rows.Line: They also mentioned a Juliet, so it seems like an adaptation of Romeo and Juliet.

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: <Yes. A loose adaptation... Judging from all actors carrying sword props, this version has more action scenes.>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate A
rows.Line: Urgh! You got me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate B
rows.Line: How could I have lost?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ha ha ha ha! That's two less Romeos to deal with!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay, all good so far! But I want this battle scene to be more bloody and dramatic!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Classmate C
rows.Line: I have an idea... Let's give each Romeo a different weapon. They all look the same when they all have swords.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's genius! What weapons do you think would work? I want to hear everyone's suggestions!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa's classmates were having a great time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes. Tsukasa really has quite a bit of charisma...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Like Miku, he's a natural mood maker.
People simply gravitate towards him.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I've noticed...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Correct me if I'm wrong, but it seems to me that you're not all that interested in events like these?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, I spent all middle school events chatting with one lonely friend on the school's rooftop...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But it may be different this time...
A lot has changed since then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Maybe if you trained for a hundred... No, a thousand... Better yet, a hundred million!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If only you trained for a hundred million light years more, you may've been a worthy rival. Alas, I shall erase you from existence here and now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Tsukasa, isn't a hundred million light years a measure of distance?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? Is there a problem? It makes it clear how entirely my rivals are just like fish out of the water!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Uh, just checking if you meant it. Hahaha.

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Rui
rows.Line: <Hehe.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
If Tsukasa's involved in this event,
I might find it enjoyable too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I seems like Tsukasa has been a positive influence on Rui too.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <He does make everything more fun for everyone.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And if there's anything I, or anyone from SEKAI, can help you with, just ask.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We're all friends after all.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure. Thanks, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You're most welcome, Rui.>
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, everyone. It's good to see you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good to see you too! Our School Festival went well and we're back to our usual schedule starting today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! That means we can do shows together again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay♪ Come on, Nene! Show us your enthusiasm too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Y-Yay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. By the way, how did you play go?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it was a huge success!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So much so that I had students who didn't get to see it coming up to me asking for another showing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's terrific.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know, right? Rui's advice, as well as yours, from when we were rehearsing definitely helped polish it to perfection. And let's not forget my incredible talent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But there's been something puzzling me since that show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was expecting the audience to be in tears after that rollercoaster of tragic emotions, but they burst into tears laughing. Was my script too much for them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. A mystery indeed...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Was it really that much fun?!
I wish I could've seen it too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too!
Can you at least tell us what it was about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah. Well, it was a tragedy about nine Romeos fighting to the death for Juliet's love.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They clash in a heated battle with sweat on their brows and blood gushing everywhere. They all fight passionately until the bitter end!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, it does! It sounds weird, but it does!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, but I showed you some parts of it at the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Perhaps we could do a performance here for everyone to enjoy?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really, KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've seen some of their rehearsals, but not the entire play.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to see it performed in its entirety, if you'd be willing, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I couldn't say no to you, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright then! Get ready for a special encore of Romeo: Battle Royale!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We'll need to prepare the stage and props.
Oh, we need to choose the actors too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Even if everyone here was given part, we wouldn't be able to fill every role.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's ask Len and the plushies to join.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good thinking! I'll go find them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! We'll get everything set up in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on. What about the script?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No problem there. I have it saved to my phone.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not that. I meant its content.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You said it was about a gory battle.
Isn't that too extreme for the plushies?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Removing fake bloodstains from them would be quite an ordeal, I imagine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I suppose we could tone it down to make it suitable for all audiences, like our Wonder Stage shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for bringing that up, Nene. And Tsukasa, for being so accommodating.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, a star has to understand how his audience feels as well!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So I'd better get started with revising the script then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay. Let me help you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, is that everyone?

rows.Speaker: Len & Plushies
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shall we assign who will be playing each Romeo now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In order of appearance we have: Hammer Romeo, who dies from stubbing his pinky toe; Tonfa Romeo, who dies from looking the wrong way...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hahaha! That's hilarious!
Their causes of death are too funny!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's more where that came from!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehehe! This is gonna be a tough choice♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Tsukasa really never fails to make people around him smile.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, most of the roles are assigned now.
Wait, KAITO doesn't have a role yet.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What will it be for me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You'll be Ninja Star Romeo, who dies from biting his tongue while speaking too fast!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, why don't I get a choice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that leaves...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: H-Hey, can't we discuss this...?!
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Humhumhum♪ Humhuum♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's been a while since I last came here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And I don't see anyone...
I was hoping to meet them all too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, that means MEIKO and Miku must be at the cafe...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm parched. I could use something to drink too.
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello! Long time no...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? There's no one here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That's strange. The sign said, OPEN...
Maybe they went somewhere...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But I'm sure they'll be back soon.
I'll just have a seat for now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, the nice aroma of coffee fills this place like always...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: K-KAITO?! What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The sign said you're open, so I decided to come inside. Did I surprise you...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, we were in a bit of a hurry and I think we forgot to flip the sign on our way out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So you're not mad that I came in while you were out?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, I'm not mad, just surprised.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what'll it be?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... I was craving a cold brew but I am pretty thirsty, so how about a regular iced coffee...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. I got some special beans in today. You know, the kind you said you liked so much?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really? Mind if I take a look?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't mind as long as you don't make a mess.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I promise...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, this is nice...
Coffee has such a soothing aroma.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? There's something written on the side...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How to grind them, what filters to use, what temperature to steep them at...? So many details...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that? It's just a few notes about how to brew your coffee just right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... I don't know what to say. It's like you're giving me so much attention!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're probably the biggest stickler in terms of how you want your coffee made. I'm not saying that's bad or anything...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It actually makes me kind of happy that you can tell when I do something different.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Toya's been developing that sort of tongue lately as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Toya...? Oh, you mean one of the people that made this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. He really seemed to enjoy me making a few special blends just for him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds nice!
I'd like to sit down and have a chat about coffee with him someday.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What's he like?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He's a very good kid. Very quiet and enjoys reading. Of course, he likes singing as well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Rin and Len also seem to enjoy hanging out with him too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The four of them usually come here together, so I'm sure you'll be able to meet Toya sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks. I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And your coffee is just about ready, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, thank you! If you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahh, this...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It wouldn't feel right if I didn't have a cup of your best, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I'd like to say...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm back, MEIKO, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, welcome back!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome home, KAITO!
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, KAITO.
Here's that blend we were talking about.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's nice...
You really do make the best coffee.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, stop. Flattery won't get you anywhere with me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Aww...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you really love coffee, don't you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's just so interesting, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Interesting how?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Each type of bean, how they're blended together, how fine or coarse they're ground, how they're steeped, how they're brewed... All of it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The sheer number of combinations gives you so many paths to choose from. There's no end to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. So you enjoy trying different types and blends?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And speaking of which... Toya is a bit of a connoisseur himself, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I finally got to meet him, but we didn't get a chance to talk about coffee.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They had their hands full with what was going on with Akito, so I'm not sure he would've had the time to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. But now that things have settled down, you may get your chance soon.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, lo and behold...

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, it's so nice to see you!
Especially you, Toya! I've been waiting to have a chat with you!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! I heard from MEIKO and the others that you're a bit of a coffee expert, and I've been wanting to pick your brain about a few things!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm not really an expert...
I just enjoy good coffee is all...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's what I'm saying! It's natural to want to enjoy something you like to the fullest, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Come, sit with me!
I'll be borrowing a few things, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I, um... Well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Please excuse him, Toya. I'm sure you and your team have plans to discuss...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, we were heading home after finishing practice and decided to stop by...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, if that's the case, would you mind lending Toya to us for a while? KAITO's been desperate to talk to him...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We don't mind, but it's up to you, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You okay with that, dude?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't mind if it's just for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: KAITO helped us with how to get through to Akito, so I feel like we owe him at least this much.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. Uh, sorry for making you do this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, if it's about coffee, I'll be happy to oblige.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO looks so excited to see you too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Don't keep him waiting!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. I'll go talk to him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO's been waiting such a long time to find someone to talk to about coffee. I hope you'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's all good. I don't think any of us knew just how much KAITO loves coffee...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He really does. He's very particular about how he wants his made and we also told him about how Toya is a little like him.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you for joining me, Toya.
The truth is, I want to create the greatest blend ever out of all the different kinds of coffee I've discovered!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would you mind doing a little taste test with me? I'm curious to hear what you have to say.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Interesting...
Are you sure about someone like me doing this?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! I want to hear from someone who truly loves coffee! Let's start with the first blend...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I see... These are quite different. The first is fruity and the second has a floral accent, yes...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nicely done!
Each one uses a different type of bean as its base.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They've been roasted in what should be the most optimal way as well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe we should've done an actual cupping session instead of a taste test like this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, excuse me. Have you heard of what cupping is? It's when you compare different beans or blends and give each a detailed score.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have no idea what they're talking about...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO is as knowledgeable about coffee as he is about music.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He may not look it, but he's very good at researching topics. What I know about coffee pales in comparison to what he knows.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I didn't know there was that side to him...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That part of him is a little complicated.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The best way to put it may be that he gets what he has to do out of the way so that he can fully enjoy what he wants to do, I guess?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Fully enjoy what he wants to do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. He generally doesn't want to spend time on anything other than the things he wants to do or enjoys doing most.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see. I sort of get how he feels.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But KAITO will be KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, what does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO...!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You promised that you'd practice singing with us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Gasp*!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um, I did...? I did, didn't I...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yes, you did!
We've been waiting forever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! KAITO, you big, stupid dummy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ahh, please...!
I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See? That's probably his biggest fail.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, one minute he sounds cool and the next he just falls flat on his face...
The day of the Project Wonder show
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe that's everyone, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even all the flowers decided to gather for this♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I didn't expect the plushies and flowers to gather like this considering how little time we have to prepare.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It is an opportunity to be in a special show that's bound to be a big hit, right? Who wouldn't want to join in on that♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah! So when are we supposed to appear?
When are they actually going to do this show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Patience, Len. I understand that you're excited, but we still need to do some final checks to make sure we all know what we're supposed to do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This show, Project Wonder... It's meant to be a monumental spectacle that can protect the hopes, dreams and smiles of so many people.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why our part, Smiling Nighttime, has to go just as well as the main part of the show! We're giving it everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's perfect!
You have some time to rest now before the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO☆ Are the flowers done rehearsing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. How about your team, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh. We're all set too♪
Never underestimate the great Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hahaha. Wonderful!
Alright, why don't we go see how the other teams are doing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, there's Team Kagamine.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Pom pom Pom pom♪ Pom pom pom pom♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow! That's so cool☆
They're all in perfect sync♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it's very impressive!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm glad Rin's enjoying herself too.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She'd gotten to know Nene and Emu more lately, and seemed to be working a little harder than I would've hoped to cheer Emu up...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's no need to worry now, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. She has Len and the plushies with her too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO, look!
It's MEIKO and Luka!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They'll be performing a song with the flowers, yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since it's MEIKO and Luka leading things here, I'm sure there won't be any cause for... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Uh oh. Luka's asleep...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I can see that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? Hello, KAITO! Miku!
Here to check up on us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, well... How are things going for your team?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Perfect♪ The flowers are doing great!
Luka said she'll be at 100% for the real thing and wants to get some rest in now...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Getting extra sleep whenever she can, huh....

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't worry♪ She might look like a sleepyhead, but she's been so excited all day!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let me prove it to you...
Flowers! One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Singing Flowers
rows.Line: Lalala♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! She can sing while she sleeps?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See♪ She can't wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Yes, I see!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, it's almost time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Has everyone returned?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Team Miku is all present!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Our team too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm all set with my lines too♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Same here! Ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is it everyone. The moment we've all been waiting for...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's a big moment for Tsukasa, us, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's make as many people as we can smile! Let's also have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay, they're here! Heeey♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Miku! Wonderhoy☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Pipe down, will you?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also feel relieved since we hadn't seen any of you since Project Wonder ended.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our show had a bigger impact than we expected, so we've been quite busy with our usual performances among other things.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not only that, we were chosen to become ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're about to become much, much busier than before!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ambassadors? Congratulations!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: However, we still don't actually know what we'll be doing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Miku, I don't see the plushies, Rin or anyone else. Where are they all?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Today's our day off and we don't have practice today♪ They might be off playing somewhere together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Let's go find them later, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since the show was a success, I guess there's no reason to worry anymore but, is Phoenix Wonderland all good now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It looks like the partnership deal is off the table and Emu's brothers are reviewing the management policy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It seems that Emu's feelings have finally reached her family.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It sure did. Plus, it was also a show filled to the brim with the thoughts and feelings of the entire Phoenix Wonderland cast. There was no way that it wouldn't move them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did all that because I wanted to cheer up Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like that show we saw together, the one that made me want to become a star...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On a subconscious level, I must have been so afraid that Tsukasa would start hating me and leave, like everyone else did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Somewhere along the way, I started to press the brakes out of not wanting to lose what took me so long to find...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry for making you worry. I'm fine now. I've been practicing since morning and am ready for anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And now, I can sing like I used to... From my heart.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want Phoenix Wonderland to be a place that makes everyone smile forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't care if you replace all the rides and get rid of the stages...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just don't want it to stop being a place where everyone can smile, laugh and be happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sure that as long as we try to do that, we'll get more and more guests to come and visit... Please...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They've all been through so much...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And even so, they never forgot their desire to make everyone smile with their shows)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! You seem happy, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's so great!
It means your smile came back full circle☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it really did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? His smile? Full circle?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's about something I told Miku earlier.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By being in a show, your smile can make your friends and so many others smile. Those smiles can even boomerang back to put one on your face!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My goal is to make it so this troupe can do just that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Thus coming back full circle.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. That circle of smiles included me as well, and they all came right back to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The circle you created, Emu, brought in Tsukasa, Rui, Nene and so many others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your shows have all touched the hearts of countless people, and that joy returned to find a home in your heart, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You really are quite something.
Your circle's come to include so many smiles.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's because everyone was there to help me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I see. That means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As ambassadors, we must expand this circle so that it will encompass this world! No, this universe...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Universe might be going too far...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It'd be great to have some space aliens see our shows♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Instead of having a space-themed show, we could have a show literally in space. Imagine the possibilities...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah.
You don't need to keep egging them on either, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Hahaha.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm so excited♪ I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO, when's everybody gonna get here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm sure they'll be here soon.
Ah, there we are...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcooome♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay, it's KAITO and Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... Is Rin not with you today?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, she's busy practicing for a show with the plushies today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So we're the only ones free to help you right now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And you'll do just fine.
We really appreciate it, KAITO, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course. You're here to discuss some things about your new show, yes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! As we mentioned before, Wonderlands×Showtime has been given the honor of being ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And for our first assignment, we'll be performing on a stage by the beach owned by an affiliate hotel!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The beach? That sounds fantastic. A show by the sea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! That's gonna be so much fun with the water being so wavy and sparkly♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Just like the Seaside School...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, do you already know what sort of show you'd like to do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be paying homage to the Little Mermaid this time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've been asked to put on a family-oriented show, so we'd like to take the original tragedy and turn it into something more fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've come up with some ideas pertaining to the details, but we still don't know what to do about the overall story. Mind helping us out with that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It would be our pleasure.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ You can count on us♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wonderful!
Then let's get right to it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The original Little Mermaid involves sisters as well, so you may be able to dive deeper into those relationships...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There's the human prince too.
Instead of falling in love, it may be better to have them simply become friends...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, me next! What if we do a story that everyone can have fun with and goes all zing-zang-zoom♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Zing-zang-zoom?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, Emu, so you wish to make it more of an adventure?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How the...?!
What is it with you and Rui?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That may be because of my proximity to Miku.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sort of comes to me naturally as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I only understood the first part of what she said...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shall I add that to my Emu-to-English dictionary, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? You have an Emu-to-English dictionary? Since when?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I installed it just the other day while I was performing some maintenance on her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Great, another weird function she doesn't really need...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So what do you think?!
A story that goes zing-zang-zoom!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I think it's a good idea.
By making it an adventure, you'll be free to add in other ideas and make the story more fun overall.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The original Little Mermaid also seemed to be quite familiar with human culture, so she'd fit right into an adventure of that sort, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. Our adventure shows in particular have also been doing the best as far as we've seen.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, they're our strong suit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, as part of making sure that our first assignment as ambassadors succeeds, it may be wise to choose something we're most familiar with to start.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. It'll also be a good way to sort of show everyone what we're like, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, adventure it is.
Shall we start working on the finer points of the story?

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! Let's take a look at some of the ideas we've already come up with!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, this is a nice twist.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since you're paying homage to the Little Mermaid, this may be just what you need. For example...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would make for quite the twist! I'll be sure to consider it, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, if I were the Little Mermaid, I might flap around on the beach like a fish the first time I come ashore!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's a mermaid! Not a fish!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our ideas are coming along rather nicely!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they are. Although, I'd like to add in some scenes that bear close resemblance to the original story.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me!
Nene, didn't you see a theatrical rendition of the Little Mermaid a long time ago?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's right!
Which scenes stuck out to you the most?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You mean like when she meets the prince or asks the sea witch for legs?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, yes. That scene with her and the sea witch may do nicely.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, is that when she drinks the potion that the sea witch gives her and turns into a human?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, she drinks the potion and grows human legs.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! What if the sea witch gives her the wrong potion and turns the Little Mermaid's legs into a bunch of wriggly octopus legs?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. The witch could even say, Oops, and after that, give the Little Mermaid a potion that gives her legs but they end up being half-fish or something.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That would be hilarious.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Excellent!
These are some great ideas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We should have more than enough to spice up our script, so why don't we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sure. I'll take what we've come up with and start working in some effects too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for your help, Miku, KAITO. We promise to make this show a good one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Bye, Miku! Bye, KAITO!
See you later♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bye bye☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You had a lot of fun, didn't you, KAITO? You had this great big smiley face the whole time☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I'm just incredibly excited about seeing how their story turns out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I hope I get a chance to see it too since it's going to be such a big moment for them. Their ambassadorial debut.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, nothing.
Shall we get back to the stage?
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others are probably preparing for their final performance right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I've seen them rehearse a number of times already and know the story very well at this point, but I'd really like to witness to their big moment...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still, it'd be irresponsible of me, the troupe leader, to disappear for an entire day.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, there you are...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you know how much time we spent looking for you?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Luka? MEIKO?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're seriously asking us that?!
We have to go, now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What?! W-Wait!
Where are we going?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Again, seriously?!
We're gonna go catch the final performance of the Little Mermaid☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I actually got to see it yesterday, but I have to say, it was a wonderful show. Would you like to come see it with us, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd love to, but the plushies are supposed to do their show today...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that!
You've been fired as troupe leader♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Just for today.
Oh, here comes the new troupe leader.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Heh heh heh☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Just for today, I, the great Miku, will be the troupe leader!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Three cheers for Miku!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Hooray♪ Long live the new leader♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So for today, you've been deposed as troupe leader, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Now do you get it?
Your schedule's been cleared up, so let's hurry up and go see the show♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, all of you... Did you do this for...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe☆
Because you're always there to help us, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why we want to give back and make sure you get to have fun for a change too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't know what to say...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now then...
KAITO, shall we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's go☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, MEIKO, you don't need to yank my arm like that...!

rows.Speaker: Plushies & Miku
rows.Line:
Have fun, you guys♪
Enjoy♪
Beach Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<There we go.
Wait... Where are we?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Oh, this looks like Nene's script.
We must be just off stage.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Nonetheless, we should still be able to catch most of their show.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'll need to thank Miku and the others when I get back...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Thank you, MEIKO, Luka...
Huh? Where'd they go?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <MEIKO? Luka? Where are you?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line:
<Over here!
Tsukasa's phone was stuck in his bag.>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: <Same with Emu's.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <That's a shame. Shall we move over to Nene's phone where KAITO is?>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line:
<Sure.
Please make some room for us, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Room for all of us...?
Hold on, is that even possible...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Miku, Rin and Len said that they were all able to fit onto Emu's phone, so I don't see why not♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That's them, we're us. Are you sure that we can...?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: <Hi!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Ow!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry about that!
We should've warned you that we were coming in hot.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Th-That's okay...
But it is getting a little cramped...>

rows.Speaker: Luka's Voice
rows.Line: <Hello...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <No, wait! Th-There's no more room!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, you're right. Having you sandwiched between us does seem a bit unfair, KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, MEIKO, what if I sat on your lap?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<L-Luka, wait!
This isn't like when you use my lap as a pillow. If you try sitting on my lap now...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Eep!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wah!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <MEIKO... KAITO... I'm so sorry...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Ugh... I tried to warn you!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Please, you two... I'm getting crushed...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Phew. This is much better.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, just in time too. I think the show's about to start.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (The story about a somewhat introverted Little Mermaid and her extroverted siblings. No two characters are alike, and they're off to a good start...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Tsukasa and Emu have been captured.
That means the climax is coming up.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes. The Little Mermaid tries to save her siblings by drinking the strange potion and transforming into a robot.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hm? But I don't see Robo-Nene standing by...)

N-No, stop!
Don't kick it! This robot's a good guy!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<What's going on?
Where's all that commotion coming from...?>

Oh no...!
H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<That voice... Nene?!
Could she be in trouble?!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<She just might be.
Not only that, it's almost Robo-Nene's cue to go out...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <No! As much as I want to help, I can't move from this spot!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Tsukasa and Emu are still on stage too, so that leaves...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's he is! Rui!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, it's you three. You came to see our show? You could've told us that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That can wait. We heard Nene's voice coming from the other side of the stage...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We haven't seen Robo-Nene at all either, and she is supposed to go on stage soon.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you for the warning.
I'll see what's going on right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness!
Curtain call! They did it!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <They really did.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And despite the trouble they ran into, they managed to turn a bad situation into an incredibly good one.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I know, right?! Nene's ad-libbing was amazing! She really pulled through for them there!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, she did. Seeing how much they've all grown makes me so proud.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you both for inviting me here today...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Actually, Miku's the one you should be thanking♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <That's true. She's the one who initially mentioned anything about wanting you to see their show live.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'll make sure to thank her when I get back.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Good!>
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aha, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Sorry to bother you like this in the middle of guitar practice, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Can I help you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
