rows.Line: We were thinking that it's about time you met Ichika and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not ready yet I take it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, I arrived so late...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ugh... Dwelling on that's only going to make things worse, you know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But they've even found their true feelings already...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wasn't here for them during their most important moment, so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, is that what this is really about?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Quit worrying so much!
Just look at me. I wasn't here for that either.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You may be fine with that, MEIKO, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This sounds like...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Didn't they finish and go home already...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but that must be Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She may be staying back to write the lyrics to Saki's song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Lately, she's been coming here to work on stuff all by herself.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now's probably not the best time to disturb her. We should give her some space so she can focus.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This is a very nice song...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (As if it's meant to cheer up those who listen to it.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And she's trying to write lyrics that go along with that...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see someone's gained some interest.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You felt it too just now, didn't you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wish you two would stop trying to read me like that...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But yes, I am a little interested...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't you want to really hear what they sound like, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then why don't you listen to one of their recordings from practice?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The guitarist is the one writing the lyrics.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She didn't seem too confident about playing that part... Oh, this part too...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Maybe she's worried about the way she's playing...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What do you think?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The bassist is very good...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, the other three seem too concerned about the way they're playing. As a result, they're not syncing up well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The guitarist in particular. She's singing just fine...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But the way she's playing...
It's as if she's doing everything she can just to keep up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it...? Why are you grinning like that, MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because you seem genuinely interested in how they're doing, silly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Seeing is believing, no?
I think it's past time you met them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, we'll introduce you to them just before the start of practice tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Th-There's no escape now...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (No, it's time...)
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichika...
You're here earlier than usual.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, I don't have school today and I was hoping that I could chat with you some before practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With me...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it's about our show...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As glad as I am that we got through it, I'm worried about how powerless I felt that day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Be it how I performed or how our song turned out, I want to get better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to keep practicing so that we can touch people's hearts someday with our music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So would it be okay if I keep asking you for help from time to time?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, of course. If you're okay with me that is...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me that much...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They seemed fine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How interesting these lyrics sound isn't what's important. How you feel should take priority, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Those words really helped me move forward.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They did? Then, I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're all so amazing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whenever we feel lost or hit a wall, you're all there to encourage and cheer us up, right? I don't know what we'd do without you guys.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, we're just doing our job...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, that's not the whole story.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You and the others have this uncanny ability to express how you feel exactly the way you want to, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The rest of us aren't able to do that yet, which is why I think you're all so incredible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I actually think you girls are the truly incredible ones...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Happiness, fun, sadness, pain, hopes and dreams...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your music includes this wide palette of emotions, which makes it so we can become whatever we want to be.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You too have an uncanny ability to put how you feel into words, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You should be very proud of that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I should?
Is it really okay for me to be proud of that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I think so.
Plus...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You've finally managed to open that door. Are you really not going to walk through it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That door... To our dream...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to go pro...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to go pro with Shiho, Saki and Honami. I want us to go pro as Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
KAITO...
I'll go through it, and I'm not gonna stop there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (You girls are really something else.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Someday...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'll be there singing with you.)
Stage SEKAI
Three, two, one... Start the music!
song00002_off_f
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone!
You guys synced perfectly during your song and dance!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Len!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You know, this show might've been the most well-made one that we've ever done.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree♪ We did spend quite a bit of time practicing everything.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we did♪ All our other preparations for the show went really smoothly too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly. We didn't have any problems with missing speakers, costumes or the like at all this time.
Heavy equipment coming through behind you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, sorry.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Was that...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We probably didn't run into any trouble because of that “equipment checklist”, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. We were done setting everything up before we knew it just by following what that list said.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for putting this together, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm? That wasn't me.
I thought that was MEIKO or Luka made and handed it out to us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Huh? I didn't write that.
I thought it was Miku or Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, it wasn't me either.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Then, who put this thing together and handed it out to us?
I have cold drinks ready for all of you here. Please take one if you need to cool off.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, thanks!
Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: S-Stop right there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: K-KAITO?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. What's going on with all of you?
You look like pigeons that were just shot by a peashooter.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Don't give us that.
Where have you been all this time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What he said.
It's been a while since you last sang...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I was going around to each stage to see what kind of equipment they each have.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: From what I understand, you were having some trouble with your shows at first, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Such as not having the right lights available or not having any replacement speakers on hand.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that happened a lot and always put us in a bind!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And it's a shame to have to waste any time on that, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why I decided to write up a checklist saying where you can find how many of each piece of equipment to streamline the preparation process for shows.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you were the one who wrote that checklist...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We all forget things, so it's a way to counter that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did I go too far...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, not at all.
We had so few issues compared to normal this time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That list really made preparing for today's show super smooth♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree. I ended up using it as well♪
It showed what was done and still needed to be done so clearly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that! It effectively prevented us from accidentally forgetting to do anything!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It did? That's great to hear!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once all the equipment has been fixed and the venue's been inspected, we won't be having any more of these issues, so I ask that you please bear with me just a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you very much, KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: By the way, KAITO, aren't you going to do your own show?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
It'd be great to see you perform after all this time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd love to see that!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I actually plan on doing my own show once I'm done inspecting all the equipment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I hope you'll be there to see it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let's see. It should be around here somewhere... Aha, there you are, laser lights!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It can shoot red, green and blue lasers. Alright, this should be able to give everything a dance-party feel to it like MEIKO said.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now to carry it over to the show stage.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm...?
I thought I heard someone's voice coming from the practice area just now.
Move your arms faster and raise them higher! Good, just like that!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I knew it. It's Haruka and Minori.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. They seem to be hard at work too.
Alright...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew... I-I'm so tired...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You did great, Minori.
That last part went so well too. Try not to forget the way you raised your arms and timed everything just now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I won't! Thank you for helping me like this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Also, I'm parched.
Where'd I put my tea... Oh no.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We practiced so long that my tea became lukewarm. I was really hoping that it would stay cold...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's not good for an idol to look so sad.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here, take one. I'm sure you're tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you have drinks... They're cold too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm hoping that I got them just right. I wouldn't want you to come down with something by cooling off too fast.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'll take one as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ahh! That hits the spot!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you very much, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
If you'll excuse me, I have other business to attend to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Business?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I was just in the middle of carrying some lights over to the stage MEIKO will be using for her show.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
If that's the case, we're sorry for keeping you like this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, don't mind me.
I just wanted to give you two a little boost since you were both so hard at work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did you see the way Rin and Len turned just now?! Absolute perfection!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness too... Those two have been working so hard on how they turn...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The first time I met you in SEKAI, KAITO, I could tell just how much you wanted to help those around you in a way that made them shine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Helping everyone shine...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You're not just an idol, but a manager too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
I help with everything from managing everyone's schedules to stage effects and many other things behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, that's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, you did mention how you liked being on stage and working behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Exactly. Being a manager and working behind the scenes gives me a better understanding of the practical side of things.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The practical side of things...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes. For example, schedules.
The others each have their own preferences and ways of doing things.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Take Rin.
She likes having as much time as possible set aside to practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: On the other hand, Miku and MEIKO prefer to schedule more time for rehearsals.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Some prefer to focus more on their craft while others prefer to simulate a real show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, but at the same time, they don't necessarily do these things consciously. To them, these things are entirely feel-based or subconscious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And putting together an actual schedule makes that very clear.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So whenever I do notice anything, I try to tell the others and work it into their respective schedules.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So you're saying that we stand to gain quite a lot in terms of skills or efficiency by shining a light on what we do subconsciously.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You can learn all about how a show functions from the other side, which in turn can make planning for a performance much simpler.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right. We just did an event in real life the other day, I learned all sorts of things about lighting and stuff.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's what I'm talking about! In my case, I'm doing this as sort of a hobby and for my own personal betterment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, “hobby” may be putting it too lightly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO's rehearsal is about to start.
I should get this over to her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Again, sorry for keeping you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm glad we got a chance to talk to you, KAITO! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I had fun too.
Also, don't stay out too late, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: We won't!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll see you later.
Gates of the Hellish Yard

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I hear a gavel...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Does that mean a trial is about to start?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
My name?
Am I to take the stand right here, Master of the Hellish Yard?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Hah. Fine. We shall see if you can pass judgment on me.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
I am Gallerian Marlon.
The Director of the USE Dark Star Bureau.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Wait...
I have only told you my name. How can you already have a verdict?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
What am I being charged with?
What about my right to not self-incriminate?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: And where is the prosecution? Where is my lawyer? Are there any witnesses? You toy with me in such a manner...?!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: It suits me...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Haha... Hahahaha...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Am I being punished for my life's transgression?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (If there is anything that I am guilty of, it is for having that affair with Ma...)

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (Or is it because I did not cherish my wife enough? Or for not going on that trip with her and Michelle?)

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (If I chose differently then, would my future also have turned out differently?)
One day, in life
Gallerian's Room

rows.Speaker: Gallerian's Voice
rows.Line: You spent more money without asking again...? Just what exactly are you doing with it?!

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Hmph. I already explained everything to you, and you even said, “Do as you please.”

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Whose fault is it for not listening to what I was asking and deciding instead to focus on work?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian's Voice
rows.Line: What?! That means you deliberately chose that point in time to ask!

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Yes, you are correct.

rows.Speaker: Wife's Voice
rows.Line: Isn't a judge's job to hear each side's argument? And yet, you are deaf to what your own wife says. Oh, the irony.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian's Voice
rows.Line: Speak for yourself! What do these dirty tricks say about you as a mother?! Are you not ashamed of yourself?!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
...
Fair enough. That money came from her side of the family anyway.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: And I have more pressing matters to attend to...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I am at long last the Director of the USE Dark Star Bureau. Not only that, I still need to read through these court documents.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: First, I need to...
Daddy, are you still working...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Michelle...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: No, dear, come in.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line:
Thank you, daddy.
I want to talk to you about my trip...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Your trip?

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: Yes. I plan on going while I'm still on break since I'll definitely be too busy once I begin university.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Are you going with your mother?

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: Yes. Which is why you should go too, daddy.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I am far too busy to take a vacation right now. I was just appointed as a judge. You must understand.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: I see... That's too bad.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: It will certainly be lonely...

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: The servants will still be here, right? Also, I promise to call every day.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
It will still feel lonely.
Please, be careful not to let any strange boys pull one over you.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: Oh, daddy, you're such a worrywart.

rows.Speaker: Michelle
rows.Line: I promise to bring back plenty of souvenirs!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Thank you, Michelle.
Have fun. Enjoy yourself.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
My wife and Michelle took their trip...
Across the ocean to my old home...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Michelle even called me every day like she promised, and told me about what happened each day in that cheerful tone of hers.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: She also finished each call with, “Let's talk more once I get back!”...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: She seemed so happy whenever she called me.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: She never came back...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Who goes there...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
(I fired all of the servants...
There should be nobody else except...)
Pardon my intrusion, Gallerian.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Ma... What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: You look terrible. Have you been eating? What would Michelle say if she ever saw you in such a state...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: You dare speak her name in my presence?!

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line:
My, all that rage.
Just take a deep breath.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: If you cannot stay calm, I will not be able to tell you about how to get Michelle back.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Do you remember our discussion surrounding the “Vessels of Sin”...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: The Venom Sword, the Glass of Conchita, the Four Mirrors of Lucifenia, the Clockworker's Doll, Kayo's Scissors, the Marlon Spoon and Grim the End...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Yes, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Each is inhabited by a demon and those who enter into a deal with them are blessed with various powers, but...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Most all end up destroying themselves.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Indeed. Each “crime” is accompanied by a “punishment”.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line:
Gallerian...
You are to gather the “Vessels of Sin”.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What...? You expect me to destroy myself after losing my beloved daughter?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: No. Do you not recall the other piece of information that I mentioned regarding the “Vessels of Sin”?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: How gathering all seven allows that person to have their wish granted?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Any wish...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Any wish. Not only that, the Marlon Spoon, one of the “Vessels of Sin”, is already in your possession.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: However, the Demon of Greed is not inhabiting it, so you will not be able to access its powers.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Instead, it is being inhabited by the spirit of “the one searching for whom they love”.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Whom they love...

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: That spirit will surely be able to guide you.

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Now, you must submit yourself to it...

rows.Speaker: Ma
rows.Line: Make up your mind, Gallerian Marlon...!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Michelle...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: (If it means getting to see you again, I will gladly submit myself to a demon.)
Gallerian's Room

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: The Marlon Spoon. One of the “Vessels of Sin”...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I made a deal with the spirit inhabiting it and now have my daughter back, albeit in an imperfect form.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Oh, Michelle.
Ma was kind enough to bring you some scripts.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: You must be so bored not being able to go outside. These should help with that some, no...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: With me? Yes, we can read some together later.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I promise to work hard to make sure that we can.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Afterwards, when the servants returned, they froze when they saw my daughter.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I suppose anybody would. The departed had returned. Not without some lower-limb issues, but returned no less.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Just you wait, Michelle.
Daddy promises to make your legs all better.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
And so, I must find them all...
The “Vessels of Sin”...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: In order to accomplish that... I require more funds.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Gathering information and actually buying them off from others will not be cheap. Bribes may become necessary as well...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Regardless, no half measures.
Gates of the Hellish Yard

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What do you wish to tell me, Master?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: You claim that I did not pass judgment based on evidence or the truth? That I was at the mercy of the highest bidder?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: The innocent were convicted while the guilty ran free...?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Hmph...
What of it?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: With enough money, evidence-based truth would have prevailed. The innocent would not have had to pay and the guilty convicted.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What is it? Speak up, will you?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: My friends turned their backs on me?

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: That is because of their selfishness!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: They simply could not understand just how much Michelle meant to me...!
In life

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate A
rows.Line: I will be resigning from my position at the Dark Star Bureau.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What?! No, who said that you could?! Certainly not me...

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate A
rows.Line:
Ugh...!
I've had enough!

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate A
rows.Line: You let that general go free.

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate A
rows.Line: The monster that butchered all those innocent villagers after falsely claiming that they were in cahoots with a terrorist organization! We lost people as well!

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate A
rows.Line: The other side also seems to already possess evidence showing that you were receiving bribes...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate B
rows.Line: I shall be leaving as well...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: You too?! Both of you are abandoning me...?!

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate B
rows.Line: No, you did this to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate B
rows.Line:
Gallerian...
In time, you must face the music.

rows.Speaker: Old Subordinate B
rows.Line: It would only be fitting considering who you are.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Soon afterwards, the media would get wind of the skeletons my cronies and I were hiding...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: The people would not stand for this. They saw it as a signal to rise up against all forms of injustice, be it legal, political, economic, or military.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Some of them even had their sights set squarely upon me.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: And then, I...

rows.Speaker: Citizens
rows.Line:
The evil general? Lock 'em up!!
The greedy judge? Lock 'em up!!

rows.Speaker: Citizens
rows.Line:
Who's going on trial? Them!!
Where's the gavel falling? On them!!

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Trapped, like a rat...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: The Venom Sword, the Glass of Conchita, the Four Mirrors of Lucifenia, Kayo's Scissors and the Marlon Spoon...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
Five out of seven...
I was so close to saving Michelle...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Michelle...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, Michelle. I never meant for you to be sucked into this mess...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: But there is a silver lining to all this. We will be together until the end...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Regardless of what awaits me on the other side, everything will be just fine. I have plenty of money to spare.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: After all, they say, “Money is the best lawyer.” Especially where I may very well end up.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: As long as I have my money, I can continue gathering the “Vessels of Sin” even on the other side. I will come back for you.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line:
We will be together again...
We can finally be happy. I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: That will be it for my defense...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: However, Master of the Hellish Yard, this farce of a trial and your pithy verdict will no longer be necessary.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I have no intention of being judged by the likes of you.

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: Just you wait, Michelle...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: I will get you back...

rows.Speaker: Gallerian
rows.Line: H-Haha... Hahahaha!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough for our final practice! I think our song and dance are good to go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yay...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great work up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, which just leaves rehearsing in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's keep doing everything we can to make sure KAITO's anniversary show goes well.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now, why don't we get changed to stay warm and head over to SEKAI a little early?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wait!
There's something I want to do here before we do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, not actually do, but watch...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You want to watch something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. The anniversary stream for KAITO's going to start in just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you mean this KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Ichika told me about how they're going to be streaming his anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I was hoping to watch it before we headed over to SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever seen any of this KAITO's shows or streams before.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd like to see what it's like as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We still have time, so why not?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. We can watch it after we get changed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I heard that they'll respond to some of our comments, so I'm curious to see how exactly...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, this could also be a learning experience for us in terms of doing streams.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you know when it's supposed to start, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Gimme just one second. Um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! I-It starts in ten minutes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-Why didn't you tell us that first...?!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Welcome to KAITO's anniversary show, everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We made it. Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, we could've just started watching it while we were changing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-No way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is his anniversary stream!
We all need to wear cute or at least nice clothes while sitting crisscross applesauce!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Criss-cross applesauce...?
That might be going a little too far...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And thank you to everyone celebrating KAITO's anniversary by watching the stream. Can you all hear us okay?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Aren't you going to write a comment, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you're right! I got so caught up in the show that I forgot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
How about...?
<I'm celebrating with my friends!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, maybe I should add that we're on our school's rooftop?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Look, here comes KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you for coming to my anniversary show today, everyone.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And hello to everyone watching the stream. I hope you enjoy everything as well.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <KAITO! Over here!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We wanna do a big lap of the stage together, so let's head over to where Miku and the others are!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, so hurry!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. I'll be right there.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, looks like Rin and Len are his escorts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem so excited about celebrating his anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Look, they're waving at us! They're so cute together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At this point, KAITO sort of seems like a distant cousin or relative.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get what you mean. Also, he's the star of today's show, so he has every right to take the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's like he wants everyone else to have a chance to stand front and center, you know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That may be because he cares about Miku and the others so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, the show's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! A duet with MEIKO to start things off!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This song's so romantic too. It suits them so well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really does. It also compliments the celebratory theme of the show very well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, working these extra dimensions into a show isn't exactly easy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know it was just their first song, but this show's already super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd say it's a testament to just how amazing their song was just now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. The chorus gave me goosebumps because it was so good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. KAITO seems so happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, he does.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need to really do our best to make sure our show in SEKAI today goes as well as possible so that our KAITO gets to feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Of course!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome to KAITO's anniversary show, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I caught a glimpse of KAITO taking a peek at the crowd just now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
He seemed so surprised.
He may not have been expecting so many people to be here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is it really that surprising?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, there are heaps more people celebrating by watching the stream, which adds up to a ton of people.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And thank you to everyone celebrating KAITO's anniversary by watching the stream. Can you all hear us okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Look at all the messages that are coming in! There are so many!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, this person said...
<I took today off to watch this stream.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like others are watching with their friends and families.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm?
<I'm watching with my friends from our school's rooftop.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like all sorts of people from many different places are here to celebrate alongside KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, why don't we have today's star come join us?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line:
Alright, ready?
One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITOOO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to my anniversary show today, everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And hello to everyone watching the stream. I hope you enjoy everything as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We wanna do a big lap of the stage together, so let's head over to where Miku and the others are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, so hurry!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. I'll be right there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All together now, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, all of you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, thank you to everyone in the audience, as well as all those watching the stream!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You were the reason I was able to have such a fun and wonderful year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I'd like to show my appreciation by singing for you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, I put quite a bit of thought into this set list.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope you enjoy the songs I've chosen for it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Looks like they can't wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I feel the same way. I've been looking forward to singing for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we get started?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay. Ready, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course!
Here's our first song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Allow me to thank you all again for joining us here today for this celebration!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are so many comments about your duet and even your solo songs. They really seem to be enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, some people are saying that your set list's really fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, they are?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can see why too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For example, right when you're expecting to hear a mellow and mature song, the next one opens with a cymbal crash.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that! We knew beforehand, but I'm sure everyone else was really surprised!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: One person even said, “He's going off the rails!” I saw that just as I was about to sing and almost burst into tears laughing.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like they all really enjoyed your idea!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it was definitely worth the effort.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Unfortunately, this will be our last song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It really is too bad...
But before we get to that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've prepared some special messages for you, KAITO♪
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO!
I can't help but ask you for help sometimes because you're such a nice person.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At the same time, I'd like it if you could rely on me more as well! I'll do whatever I can to help!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO!
You're always willing to listen to my demands and greet me with a smile whenever I prank you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So if you ever want to pull a prank on someone else, I'll be there to help! Hehe!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shouldn't you be saying that you'll try to ask less of him moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: R-Right... I promise to try doing that too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Haha. But I get how she feels.
It's never not fun whenever you're around, KAITO, since you're always willing to just hang out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which sort of might be a sign of me asking you to hang out with me too much, so I'll try to be less demanding...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I still want to do lots and lots of stuff with you moving forward!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, KAITO!
Your big heart's been a huge source of support for all of us, myself included.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm having a bit of a hard time imagining you and Rin pulling a prank on someone together...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But if you are, I say do something big! I may even be willing to lend you a hand in secret♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It won't be much of a secret if you say it here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Anyway, KAITO, happy anniversary.
I think it's incredible how your presence alone can cause people to stop fighting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It must be because you're such a kind and caring person.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As far as I know, only you carry such a wonderful quality, so my hope is that you'll continue carrying that light.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you...
All of you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Please, feel free to ask me for help whenever. You will never not be welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As far as pranks go, I don't mind being the one being pranked since it's usually a fun experience in the end...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But this could be a good opportunity for me to try pulling one on someone else.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I could even make that one of my goals for this upcoming year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Just kidding!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Luka, MEIKO & KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I can't believe I left my sheet music behind in the classroom...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Was I that interested in Shiho's story...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (To be honest, it pained me to hear what she went through...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(However...
I was able to learn a little more about Shiho.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh. Hi, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: H-Hello...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... You're early...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know. I was hoping to work on a few things before the others got here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing here, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I left my sheet music here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I don't want to interrupt her with her practice. I should find that sheet music and...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh...? It's not here...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, Luka and Honami were cleaning up the locker area yesterday. They may've swept it up and put it away somewhere by accident...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'll help you look.
It's the sheet music for song you were practicing the other day, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (We might find it faster by working together, and free her up to practice...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'd rather not take away from her time...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright... I'll try looking over here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll look over there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This is nice... Sort of...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Is it because I learned about an important phase of her life yesterday...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry, but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you always come here this early to practice on your own?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, only when I have some free time.
I usually just practice at home.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't see that sheet music anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Same.
We can try... That shelf, maybe?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, this looks like a bundle of sheet music...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I'd feel bad about taking it apart after it's been so neatly put together...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can just bundle it back up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Alright...
Can you take this half?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why are you giggling, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I couldn't help it. We've never really had a chance to talk like this is all.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh... Do you feel uncomfortable talking to me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, nothing like that...
Actually, it feels like you've been tip-toeing around something for a while now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No... Not intentionally at least...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, that's good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't talk very much when I'm in these kinds of situations, so it feels a bit unusual.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh... I feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's not that I don't like chatting, but I'm not very talkative...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Same.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... You said that you've always had trouble working with others on things.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Talking in particular has probably been my biggest failing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I always have trouble holding back and tend to just speak my mind, which usually doesn't end well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I regret my mistakes and know I need to fix that part of me, but it's so hard.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But I've never seen her raise her voice or get mad over something for no reason...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She's also the one who usually suggests when to take breaks, which clearly means she's looking out for everyone.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Saying hurtful words isn't good...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But being too afraid of taking chances and not saying anything just wouldn't be you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ichika and the girls...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm certain that they're willing to listen to everything you have to say.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's why I think you should just say what you feel whenever you're with them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And if that doesn't work out...
It's okay. You'll always have us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess that's one way to go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't thank me. I was just speaking my mind... Oh, here it is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho. I found my sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I know. I was planning on practicing this song, so why don't you join me for practice?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (We might be able to play it really well right now...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll go get my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly.
School SEKAI - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There you are, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Were you practicing just now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Not really...
Is something going on?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were hoping to get in some practice before the girls came.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're looking for one more to fill out our group, but Miku and Luka are busy practicing a different song.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I will.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Phew...
Alright, that should be good!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for practicing with us like this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
I've been meaning to work on this song as well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I can still keep going...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, if you're in the mood, mind working with me on this one part? It's still sort of bothering me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay♪ You're the best!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for helping out, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome...
I really had nothing else to do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? I felt kinda bad interrupting you at first since you seemed to be having fun playing your guitar...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You really don't have to mind me that much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I understand how it's easy to get sucked into your own little world when you're working on something.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I honestly wouldn't want anybody interrupting my concentration.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I see. If I'm trying to focus on something, then I'd feel the same way...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right? You know what they say...
“Good fences make good neighbors.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Plus, Shiho's story taught me that I need to cherish the bonds I've established with others and take good care of myself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Bonds...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, what do we call ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're not “childhood friends” or just “friends”, you know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
How about “bandmates”?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's probably the best answer.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That reminds me... What was it like when you first arrived here and met everyone, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What was it like...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was glad that they were here, I think...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, if I were the first one here, I'm not sure Ichika and the girls would've been able to discover their true feelings...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I get what you mean... Based on what I've heard from MEIKO and Luka, it took them a pretty long time, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What was it like in your case, Len...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Surprising since Rin started treating me like her junior...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But at the same time, the seniority system we have in place works really well for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Luka and MEIKO definitely seem like the seniors at this school.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, what about me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You, KAITO...?
I'd say we're just barely classmates.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just barely...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't mean that in a bad way or anything. I'm trying to say that you're really easy to talk to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It might be fun to ask the others about how they interact with each other.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it might. We really don't talk enough about ourselves...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Exactly. We always go on and on about music, practice, Ichika and the girls...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So we should have a chat about ourselves sometime.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like that.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go!
Let's dance!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Miku, Rin, you're going a bit too fast! Try to copy what Emu and Len are doing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Nene, would you mind clapping your hands to provide a beat for them?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, sure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Ready, you guys?
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay☆ Clap your hands like...
One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, much better!
Thank you for that, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're most welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (With Nene and MEIKO here, our dance team should be in good hands.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Now, how's the script team doing...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist and the girl are supposed to become better friends here, but it feels thin at this point. If possible, I'd like to spice it up somehow.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Well, the central themes of this show involve family, friends and bonds...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So what if the protagonist is able to make new friends because of this girl or becomes closer to this uncle they're living with...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, that could work.
Which just leaves...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Looks like they're having a productive discussion as well.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm really looking forward to seeing how this show turns out.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(And that SEKAI. That tree...
It glistened with everyone's thoughts and feelings.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Also, that tree could conceivably grow even bigger if Tsukasa and the others keep growing as performers.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry, KAITO, but would you mind if we asked you something?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, is this about the script you were just discussing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It seems solid up through the middle, but we're having trouble with the ending.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's why we want to hear what you think, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll gladly join your discussion.
Can you tell me what kind of story you're trying to tell?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Our protagonist is an introverted girl who plans to spend her spring break by just reading.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, her parents have quite a lot to prepare as they're about to welcome a new family member into the world.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the time being, the girl is sent off to the countryside to live with her uncle and his wife.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But she has trouble adjusting to this new environment. Not only that, she starts feeling lonely because there aren't any other children her age in this village.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a result, she's driven towards trying to find her way back to her beloved parents all on her own.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As she ventures up the mountain on her uncle's property, she comes across a girl her age named Some sitting under a cherry blossom tree.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Some...?
Does this cherry blossom tree happen to be a Somei-yoshino?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly!
Some's actually a cherry blossom spirit.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As such, she's able to conjure up cherry blossoms from her hands and even cause petal blizzards.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our protagonist is drawn towards Some's wondrous powers and they soon become friends.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But as they grow closer, we're thinking that she'll begin figuring out Some's true identity.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After Some and the protagonist become friends, they promise to meet again the next day and she heads back to her uncle's home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Her meeting Some also results in being able to open up to her uncle more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But one night, her uncle goes out to gather some herbs from the mountain and shows no signs of returning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. What happens next?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The protagonist begins blaming herself for saying, “I want to try those herbs again.” Thus, she feels responsible and goes out searching for him.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, the night is no time for a girl to be searching a mountain alone, and she soon becomes lost as a result.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just as she's about to cry, our cherry blossom spirit, Some, appears.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She decided to help search for the protagonist's uncle by calling out to her Somei-yoshino siblings who also live in the mountains.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I've heard a story that Somei-yoshino cherry blossoms originate from just one tree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
That's how we plan on presenting the idea of “siblings” during our show.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Emu will be playing the role of Some, and I'm thinking about having multiple copies of her during this scene.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, multiple copies of Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I still don't understand how he plans on doing that, but let's continue...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ultimately, the location of the protagonist's injured uncle will be revealed thanks to Some's help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And a path lined with cherry blossom petals will guide them back to the villagers who've been searching for them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds like a very moving climax.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I agree. I believe we have a solid story up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, we're having trouble with the scene where Some and the protagonist have to say goodbye to each other.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Despite promising to meet again next spring, the somberness of having to part ways seems to overpower everything else because they've become such close friends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Meeting again next spring...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. As it stands, we've made it so Some can only appear when the cherry blossoms are in bloom.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (If I were a cherry blossom spirit...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Some wants to meet this girl again, yes? It might be good to make it so she doesn't have to wait the entire time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For example, Some could try finding a way to gather enough energy to make the cherry blossoms look even more beautiful the following year...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It could be her way of making the cherry blossoms stay in bloom longer so that she can be with her friend as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Just as we want to do everything we can to make your dreams come true.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure Some would want to do everything in her power for her precious friend.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's fantastic...! Alright, that means the protagonist should also have a goal to work towards.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I agree... What if she finds the resolve to become a good older sister for her new sibling?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Especially since Some's already a big sister with many siblings!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you, KAITO.
The final part of the story is really coming together now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're most welcome.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure it's going to be a wonderful story. I'll be looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! You can count on us to make it a good one!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Background. Check. Lights. Check... Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa, we can start rehearsing whenever.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene! Emu! Everything ready over there?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We're all set!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start rehearsing...
“A Wondrous Spring Break With Some”...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Mom, I said I don't want to...!
Why are you making me go to someone else's house?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “I'm not going! I don't want a little brother if it means I have to be dragged away from you and Dad! I don't want to be a big sister either!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Well done, Nene.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's just her on stage right now, but it really feels like she's arguing with her parents.)

“Hah hah hah hah!
A hearty hello from below!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Wahhh! M-Monster!”

rows.Speaker: Some
rows.Line:
