rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I appreciate what Saki said, but my opinion's no more valuable than anybody else's...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm really not sure that it'll be enough to convince the others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't say that!
I mean, you're KAITO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Well, you exude this aura...
Like you know the most about music out of all of us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: An aura...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, a musical one!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I don't quite understand...
But I'm glad that I'm able to help.)
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hello! I'm here to have some coffee!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Welcome, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, are you helping out today?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup. Miku and Luka are apparently out singing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin, I'll prepare the coffee, so would you mind keeping KAITO company for me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your usual delicious brew, please.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, did you see Kohane after that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? After when?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When?! Remember how she asked us for advice regarding the track she's making?! She talked about how she based it off of An's song!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, since then?
I mean, it's only been a day or so since we last met.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Also, she has to practice for that event, so visiting every day seems a bit difficult.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I'm sure she'll stop by to have us listen to her song once she's finished working on the beat, no?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We should just relax and wait patiently.
There's no point in us getting antsy, or putting pressure on her by going over to ask how she's doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know...!
But I can't get it out of my head...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Aren't you the least bit curious, KAITO?
Don't you wanna know what kind of song she's writing?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course I am.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to hearing her song very much since she seems to have a clear idea of what she wants to do.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, why does it seem like you don't really care...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Because I'm imagining what it's going to be like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-Imagining what it's gonna be like?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We got to hear what sort of sounds she sampling, as well as her overall image for her song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've been having fun imagining how Kohane's going to mix the ingredients she's gathered in her head and throwing in a few different beats. As a result, I've been able to come up with three possible patterns.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But how do you know what she's thinking?! Did you memorize every sound that she's using for her song?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I made an effort to remember as much as I could while I listened.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, is something the matter...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's just... You're really amazing sometimes, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? What's this all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because you remembered all those different sounds and came up with essentially three songs all in your head!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How's that not amazing?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... Have you forgotten that I'm a DJ?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I haven't!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, you haven't?! And you're still this amazed?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's probably because she's never seen you take being a DJ seriously, no?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Anyway, here's your coffee.
I went with a slightly darker roast today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, let's have a taste...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Mmm...!
Such a bold and deep flavor. I can feel it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, no...!
As delicious as this coffee is, more importantly...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have been taking being a DJ seriously lately.

rows.Speaker: Rin & MEIKO
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
No, you haven't.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the very least, we sure haven't seen you doing so.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Guh... Wait, ask Len!
I've been a good teacher! Honest!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... Okay, so...
Coming up with songs in your head isn't really a big deal for you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be fair, I'm just imagining them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's fairly common for those ideas to not turn out the way I want when turning them into actual sound.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway, I stand by my original point.
We should wait patiently and give Kohane some time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahh... Another day and another cup of MEIKO's delicious coffee...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Heya! MEIKO, everyone, are you all here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It feels like it's been so long since all four of you last visited together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We can't stay long since our event's fast approaching on top of us getting two new songs ready for it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, two new songs?
I thought you guys were just doing the one that you and An wrote, Akito.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We didn't plan for two originally.
Toya ended up making his own track.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And it was so awesome that we felt like we had to sing it during our next event!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cool! Way to go, Toya!
Does this mean what we discussed with Kohane that time...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rin, shush!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hm? What was that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Uhh... What I meant was... I thought it was just you and An doing the songwriting, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, we just went over that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Mind if I asked you all to listen to it...?
I put quite a lot of thought into this song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Toya...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I'm being a little selfish by wanting to make my own track. I get that I should be focusing on putting on a good performance right now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's wrong with doing what you want to do? If I were in your position, Azusawa, I would've made the same decision.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I see. Toya was in the same position as her.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna hear it!
Show us what you made, Toya!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to hear it as well!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Toya... You made this...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool! I didn't know you could make anything like this! It's like my heart's ready to jump out of my chest right now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it's quite incredible...
I can tell that you took a long, hard look at your music in order to make this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This wouldn't have been possible without all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I'm so glad that I can finally tell you all about it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Since this is Toya we're talking about, I have a feeling that something was going on... But it must've been so hard for him to keep this a secret.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Still, it's a very good track.
I agree with Rin. I'm also getting this strange feeling in my chest.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, and I have a feeling that it has the power to get any crowd going.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You come across these sorts of songs from time to time when you're a DJ.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Songs where the way the crowd reacts makes it feel like they were meant to be played by me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I get to listen to it from the closest position. I essentially have the best seat in the house.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And this is just one of those songs, you know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You'll be the ones performing this on stage. That means you're also going to be in the best seats.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that your track is going to propel everybody forward, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Forward...
That would make me very happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually, I believe it's already having that effect.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean, you're all probably having trouble containing yourselves after listening to his track, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well... Of course...
It's way different from the tracks I usually make, and it made me want to work on it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I felt the same way.
I'm coming up with the lyrics for Toya's song and keep thinking that I can do better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I want to gain more experience as a performer and sing in a way that shows everyone how much thought you all put into your songs!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And I need to do what I can to help make Kohane's track the best it can be!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, Kohane, let's do our best...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Rin, just Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: H-Haha! Don't worry about that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The way they all push each other forward... They really are an incredible team.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, indeed♪
As long as they keep doing that, they should naturally get better and better.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I'm all for them taking on these sorts of new challenges.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... New challenges, huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Do you also want to try something new, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, not me. You, KAITO.
You should try doing something new.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me? Such as...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Um... Like... Cleaning the cafe!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Opening and closing each day might be good too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe...! Yeah, it might do you some good.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... Cleaning the cafe, as well as opening and closing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Taking on new challenges is certainly important, but so is dividing up the work.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For example, I contribute to this cafe by drinking coffee every day and checking to make sure it tastes okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, to be fair, it always tastes delicious!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ugh! KAITO, you never take anything seriously!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha!
One month before the solo show
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Just one month to go until the girls' solo show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm so fired up about it...
I mean, we've been watching over them for so long, and their big moment's finally arrived.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I understand how you feel. They've been making a concerted effort to make sure their fans really enjoy the show, so I'm looking forward to seeing how it turns out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not only that, but they did great during Airi's training camp.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they did. I'm sure their fans are just as excited for the show as we are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm?
Oh, they arrived right on cue.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO! And MEIKO and Luka too!
Do you all have a second?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, how can we help?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We apologize in advance since we're not sure if we should be asking you about this, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. So this is about setting up your venue and figuring out a designated route for the audience...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For the fan event we did the other day, we were able to come up with a plan for all that with the help of the staff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we ran into some trouble when it came to actually setting everything up, which led to quite a bit of confusion among everyone. We were hoping to avoid that this time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Considering how this event's gonna be even bigger and means a lot more than that one, we can't let the same thing happen again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why we're here right now. With our previous mistakes in mind, we'd like to ask for your opinions regarding this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Will you help us?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course! I'll be more than happy to!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, since you've all been working very hard towards making your solo show a success. As such, I'd like to help you girls out in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Getting to work on your behind the scenes for your big show sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You really are an open book, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. What's wrong with being honest about how I feel?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Plus, working on their show behind-the-scenes means we're helping them shine on stage.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe idols have the ability to spread hope to not just their fans but also inspire all of those who help make their shows happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Imagine putting together the stage on which your favorite idols are going to shine like the sun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That'd definitely put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. We've been wondering how the preparations for your show were going, so getting to help out like this is nice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree! We'd be honored to lend you girls a hand♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, we'll need to make haste.
Do you have the layout for your venue along with a list of equipment?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, we also brought the instructions for where to carry and set up everything, the song files for the show and even the schedule for the day of.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The schedule Airi made is really incredible!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: With just one look it tells you exactly when and where you're supposed to be, what outfit you should be wearing and where you need to enter from!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: FYI, it wouldn't be doing its job if you couldn't tell at a glance what you're supposed to be doing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I agree with Minori. It's very easy to pick out the information one needs. I think I'll use this for future reference.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Exactly! See?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You seem way happier than I am about this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, KAITO, do you think you have enough information to help us...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, what you've given me should be more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. So, let's begin with how everything is going to be set up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much!
You've given us such wonderful advice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It was our pleasure.
If anything, it was wonderful to see exactly how your solo show was coming along. And it was very fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO's right. We were happy to help. Besides, doesn't the saying go “necessity is the mother of invention?”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like it's a tad bit different in this case.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In any case, we're all looking forward to seeing you all shine on stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Do you think you'll have any merchandise to spare?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If possible, we'd like to use what we can get to cheer you all on during the show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You sly fox...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But that would make watching their show just that much more fun♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I totally agree! You've all been there for us until now, so we'll bring some over for all of you guys.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good luck, girls.
I don't think any of us can wait at this point.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you! We promise to bring you the best solo show ever!
The day before the solo show
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's really happening...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, it happening tomorrow...
The girls' solo show...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... I figured that Rin would be feeling pretty anxious about this, but not Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you think so?
I feel that it's pretty natural.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Especially since they've been watching over MORE MORE JUMP! the longest out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And their very first solo show is really happening tomorrow. I'd sure feel anxious. Wouldn't you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I certainly would♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
Still...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh dear...
I think I'm going to have trouble sleeping again tonight.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm having a hard time understanding how KAITO feels about all this...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe that's just him being him, no♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree... But we sort of do need him to buck up sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO? If you're stuck in this state, who's going to be there to comfort Miku and Rin?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
I need to pull myself together!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
E-Everything's going to be okay.
Miku, Rin, let's all just take a deep breath...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think you need to do that the most right now, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You seemed fine when Minori and the others were here. What happened between now and then?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A-Are you kidding? Of course I can't show Minori and the others how I'm really feeling. Not before their big show! What if I made them worry?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you made sure to take their mental state into account even though you were struggling. That's impressive.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, KAITO's been worrying about them ever since they came to him for advice regarding how to set up their venue and figuring out designated routes for the audience...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: H-Hmm... I really hope everything goes well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm a lot more nervous for them than I ever was for my own shows.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Same...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... My heart's racing...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I understand why you're all worried, but I'm sure that they're going to do just fine. You both know that they worked really hard to get to this point.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They probably will because they work so hard and care about their fans so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. So, until then, we should try to relax as we wait for their curtains to go up on their big show♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, okay...
Th-Then, let's think of a way for us to have fun tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!
After the solo show
Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Th-That was so incredible...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I almost started tearing up partway through! They... They all sparkled so much...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It reminded me of just how wonderful idol shows can be. Their performance was really something else...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Minori must've worked so hard for this. She was probably doing everything she could even when we weren't there to watch...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
We sorta ran into some trouble right as we were about to go clean everything up...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Minori was about to go buy some water for us and ended up opening the staff door that leads to the main exit... Right into the view of our fans as they filed out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Airi! They don't need to know that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. More importantly, congratulations on a successful solo show! It was amazing!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
We really appreciate you all taking the time to come by and watch.

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line:
Staff, please gather!
We're going to start taking everything down now!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... I'm sorry, we need to head back...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Don't mind us. We know you girls have an after party later too. So, we'll talk again in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <W-Wait! Before you go...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Minori...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: P-Present!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You really shined on stage as you sang and danced today. And your speech at the end was so moving.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, I was really moved by that too! Just thinking about it is starting to make me... Oh no...!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<My point exactly!
That part about idols being in a position to not just give hope, but also receive was so...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <KAITO, we shouldn't keep them too long.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Especially since we'll have plenty of time to talk to them later. So, let's go.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <W-Wait... Okay, MEIKO, I understand...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Anyway, see you later in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! We absolutely promise to stop by to talk about today!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You kept your cool while you were watching them, KAITO, but it's like a switch flipped inside your head after the show was over...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
I think it's because I was so focused on not missing a moment of it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: B-But I got to see such an astounding show! How am I not supposed to feel this way...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, KAITO's right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree too! Oh no...
Just thinking about it is making me...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you.
I know you're happy, but tears don't belong on that adorable face of yours.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, idol shows really are the best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They give you hope, fill you with energy and all these different emotions... You learn so much just by watching over them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I completely agree♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And after the show's over, you get to talk about how great it was with everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO

rows.Speaker: KAITO

rows.Speaker: KAITO

rows.Speaker: Rin

rows.Line:

But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's a great photographer, but I'm not sure if videos are really her thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, more than anything, we need to focus on putting on a good performance.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
This sensation...
I think I'm more excited than anxious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure they'll achieve a wonderful result.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
Especially considering how much they've overcome already!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I want to give the girls my full support.
But how do I actually do that...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh, I know...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This phrase...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You really are something else, KAITO.
Can you tell us what was going through your mind while you were playing that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I wanted you all to see a new door opening in front of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A new door...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Does that mean you were trying to cheer us on?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it certainly did have that feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is that the phrase we heard when KAITO was being introduced to us?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
KAITO!
This means you're trying to cheer for us, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes...
I can't quite put it into words...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I hope that worked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, it definitely did.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That's good to hear...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Humhumhumhuum♪

rows.Line: You're watching the girls' music video again, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Well, it's just that good.
I can't get tired of it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! That's right. You borrowed Saki's tablet just for this, no?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, doesn't that mean you're the biggest contributor to their view count?

rows.Line:
I sorta doubt that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That seems...excessive...

rows.Line: Hehe. However, a high view count may lead to other people finding this video.

rows.Speaker: Miku

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I think they mentioned something about advertising the fact that they started their own channel...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that makes sense.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that they have their channel all set up, this is where the real fun starts.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. They'll need to start posting videos on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right! They're gonna keep making more videos! I can't wait to see them♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: At the same time... Wouldn't it be fun for us to make one?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our own music video...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! I believe we all have our little daydreams.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Daydreams, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I take it that you have an idea, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me? I don't know if this counts...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I've always thought that doing a performance in the rain and playing like it's not bothering you is really cool.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that is really cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But our instruments would get all wet...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's the problem...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
How about you guys?
Does anything like that come to mind?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Line: I like the idea of playing under the night sky since the stars look so beautiful from the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it might even be fun to use a backlight to make only our silhouettes appear.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's a great idea! Not being able to see our faces would add a nice element of mystery!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... If Len and Miku-P want to go with cool and stylish...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, I'll go with something fun and happy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna do a video that involves jumping and bouncing with lots and lots of cameras moving around as they record!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure it'd be a very cute video. Just like you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. Rin seems like the right person to ask when it comes to making fun videos...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heehee!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, what KAITO just said made me realize something...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In order to make your ideas come alive, won't they require very different songs?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Or... What if we tried bundling them up into one idea?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It can be raining with the stars out while we jump and bounce around...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Won't it be too cloudy to see the stars if it's raining?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Making this fun while keeping all our ideas intact sounds way too hard!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'm sure it's possible...
But I have a feeling that it's gonna look really surreal.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What about using a backlight? We could still jump around in the rain like we're having fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, that might actually work!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it might... However...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: However?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It could end up looking like us performing a rain dance that somehow succeeded, no...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Um...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why'd you have to go and say that, KAITO?! Now we can't get it out of our heads!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, this is my fault?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess it just isn't possible to make all three of our ideas happen at once.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Unfortunately. Especially considering how music videos revolve around specific songs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, doing a rain dance could be kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It... It could...?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, our set list seems fine...!
So, let's start discussing effects and such for our show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, can we have it snow?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Snow? Yeah, that'd be a nice way to make things feel more wintery.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. It should go very well with this set list too since we've included an assortment of winter-themed songs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! But how do we actually do that? It's not like we can make it really snow.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The confetti should work.
Oh, if we want to make it seem more real, we can try using some dry ice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a great idea! It should make for a spectacular scene!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Let me just jot that down... Confetti... Dry ice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for always taking notes for us, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no need to thank me. It's sort of become a habit, likely because I'm also a manager.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, let's move on to other suggestions.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I have one♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we wear costumes that go with the theme of our show?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, our costumes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's a good idea, but not many of our costumes have a winter feel to them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's one with a broach that looks like a snowflake, and another that's really white and poofy...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That probably won't be enough.
So, I was hoping we could do something about that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But what...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, we could try making some alterations to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I agree. I kinda want to try doing that too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: However, that means we won't be able to use them like we did before.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not a problem! We can try making them modular.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Modular? Like having detachable parts?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. For example, we could add some fur around the neck and lace trim with a snowflake pattern to the skirt.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By doing that, you'd be able to enjoy both the original and the altered version.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We don't have to limit ourselves to just winter either. This approach should let us make costumes for a wide variety of themes♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree. At the very least, we should be able to prepare costumes that go with the theme of our next show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start coming up with some ideas for alterations?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what do we actually need to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well... First, it might be good to inspect the base costume you'll be altering.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, consider which song you'll be wearing it for. That should help you come up with alteration ideas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay! Let's try that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, it's like when the girls came up with the designs for their outfits!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and now it's our turn.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup. And it looked like a lot of fun while they discussed their designs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it did!
Oh, what if I attached some wings? I could be like a snow fairy!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds like a wonderful idea!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's start picking out our costumes.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They all seem very excited about this. I might get left behind if I'm not careful.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (So, I'll try coming up with ideas for alterations that will really make them shine when they're on stage!)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Okay, I'll try placing the snowflake lace I found in a catalog of fabrics onto the skirt...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But I want to make the most of the fluffy material I chose for the sleeves like Shizuku suggested, so maybe the lace should be a slightly warmer color... Like cream...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Yes, they seem to balance each other out nicely... At the same time...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(It doesn't seem quite right...
The sample seemed perfect when I saw it, but I feel like there's something better out there...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I have a solid image in my head, but I can't seem to find the right color.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, that is pretty tricky...
Depending on the color you choose, its overall feel could change a lot...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, would you mind if we showed each other what we have and discussed ideas from there?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The truth is, I'm also a little stuck...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? I'd love to do that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We might be able to come up with some better ideas if we put our heads together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you! Then, on the count of three.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ready? One, two...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
KAITO, yours looks really well balanced.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The top and bottom halves of mine ended up being totally out of balance with one another...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you. I did my best to achieve that. However, I'm still undecided in terms of the lace I chose for this skirt...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why your drawing blew me away, Miku. The lace for yours goes so well with the original costume!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I spent a lot of time picking it out. Unfortunately, the costume's color is sort of pushing this lace into the background...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wish I knew how to find colors that compliment each accessory and such like you, Len...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait a second... There may actually be a simple solution to this problem...

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Len, you like how I balanced everything out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As for me, I was impressed with Miku's choice of lace, while she liked your selection of colors, Len.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, what if we gave each other advice regarding what we seem to be good at?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In other words, you can show me how to strike a better balance, KAITO, while I can give Miku tips for choosing colors...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I can teach you how to pick out the right kind of lace, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Precisely!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: See? We can all help each other overcome our weaknesses.

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe♪ You're a genius, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You have this way of coming up with the perfect solutions to all our problems.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And you keep finding ways to make the most of our best qualities.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, I'm doing a good job as a manager?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I suppose I do spend a lot of time thinking about how to let you all shine on stage...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-In any case, let's start fixing our alterations by giving each other some advice!

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They're...

rows.Speaker: Len, Miku & KAITO
rows.Line: They're done!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It took some time, but they turned out incredibly well!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Len, KAITO, thank you both so much!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking you two.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You three seem to be having an awful lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, welcome back!
Did you manage to find anything good to use?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, loads♪
Did you guys come up with good ideas for alterations?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. We put our heads together and found a way to complete our costumes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you're all smiling!
I'm looking forward to seeing what you came up with.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we show them right now?!

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Heeey! KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Weird.
He's pretty much always practicing in one of the classrooms.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO's Voice
rows.Line: Rin, any luck?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nope, not at all! I don't even hear his guitar...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Why is everyone looking for me...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (We all usually do what we want during this time, so I was planning to practice alone...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But they seem kind of concerned, maybe I should let them know I'm—)

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: MEIKO, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We tried looking, but we couldn't find him anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh...
Seriously, where did he go?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Even those two are looking for me...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami and Shiho said they're going to start searching from the rooftop and work their way down. So we decided to start searching from the bottom.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I guess we'll join you two and search each room again.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! Let's go find KAITO, absolutely positively☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
For everyone to be trying this hard to look for me...
Did I...do something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Now it kind of just feels difficult to go out...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It seems they all went elsewhere, so I'll stay here and keep an eye on things for a—)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you're in here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: KAITO, were you hiding?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, no...I was just here to practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But everyone's out looking for me, so...
I thought maybe I did something bad, and it became harder to go out...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, so that's all it was.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can relax. The reason everyone's looking for you is because today is your anniversary.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: My...anniversary?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So you'd forgotten...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, but...we don't need to celebrate or anything. Besides, it's embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's not going to fly.
Everyone's searching around for you because they want to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come on, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright everyone, watch KAITO to make sure he doesn't go anywhere while we finish the party preparations.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait for just a bit KAITO, we'll finish prepping in no time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They didn't need to post guards. It's not like I was going to run away...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I think they want us to give you company, since you won't have anything to do while you're waiting.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also had something I wanted to tell you, so this is perfect.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Something you wanted to tell me...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I wonder if you remember... That time when I was struggling with my lyrics, you said...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They seemed fine.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How interesting these lyrics sound isn't what's important. How you feel should take priority, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks to those words, I've become able to trust in my own feelings and express them without being ashamed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... Thank you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No... I really just said what popped into my head then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even if that's true, hearing your words meant a lot to us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad music... No, I'm glad you found a way back to your friends, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Absolutely!
I realized something really important thanks to you and Len, too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But how do I put this...?
We weren't getting the full scope of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm wondering if you're not able to really express yourself because you haven't quite found the right answer yet.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope you figure it out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm so, soooooo grateful!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: KAITO, thank you for always watching over us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
And...
Happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary!
Happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: When you bring that stuff up all over again, it's...um...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But... If I've been of help to all of you, then I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! It looks like the celebration over there is starting!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Over where...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: KAITO's anniversary show over in our world.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hello everyone! I'm happy to see you all!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
