She really wants what's best for Minori and has been showing so much concern for her...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, how are things between you, Ayumi and the others now...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're still friends.
We still greet each other when we pass by in the corridor and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I don't really get messages from her anymore. We haven't spoken in so long...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't think there's anything I could've done about all that. At the same time, it still hurts to think about it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's why I'm afraid that Minori's also going to start drifting away from her friends...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I'm not saying that's the only possible outcome. I mean, I still hang out with some of my friends from junior high...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's just... I can't help but feel worried...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi didn't seem sure about saying what she did, but I think it's okay for her...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She went through something very painful and doesn't want Minori to experience the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why it's important for her to say how she feels in this situation!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, it's a really big decision! Isn't it better to have someone there to help instead of having to think about it all alone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you think Airi's going to do...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's entirely up to her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But she's back to being her usual cheerful self thanks to KAITO here, so I'm sure she'll figure this out♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I really don't deserve so much credit...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? KAITO, your face is still red.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope Airi and that Ayumi girl can go back to chatting like old friends...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounded like they had a misunderstanding and were just trying to give each other some space out of the kindness of their hearts...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So a slight nudge in the right direction may be all that they need...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A slight nudge...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. What if they both went to the library to look for a book, reached for it at the same time and grazed each others' hands?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That sounds like the start of something else...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
Seeing each other in the corridor may do just fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In any case, I'm sure Airi will figure things out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, she has friends she can count on for help whenever♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Very true.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The owners of the feelings that gave birth to this SEKAI are such wonderful people...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO. You're just realizing this now? The rest of us have known that forever♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're each doing everything they can as idols so that they can spread hope to lots and lots of people.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Because they all believe in the same thing, they've forged this incredibly powerful bond.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They really are incredible idols...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Not only are we fellow idols, we're also big fans...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (We'll always be there by your side.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (So, Airi, I wish you the best.)
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
There we are...
The stage is nice and clean now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone also seems to be doing well practicing for our show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If we keep this up, we should be able to do a full rehearsal of...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hello, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ah, you two. Welcome.
How can I help you today?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Airi has something to report. Right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I do!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounds like you have some good news! But are you sure about telling me first?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course!
If anything, KAITO, I want you to be the first to hear this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The thing is, after you gave me that advice the other day, I went to talk with Ayumi...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: S-So, how'd it go...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You and Shizuku were right...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: Remember how you took a break from being an idol? I was so worried for you then.

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But that also sounds like just words... Before I knew it, we sort of stopped talking to each other...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... A gap began to slowly form between us after that field trip...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I didn't want to feel like a bother to you...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: But that led to talking to you less and less, which only caused us to drift apart more and more... Eventually, I felt awkward even just trying to start a conversation with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean for any of that to happen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You were never a bother...
I was afraid of disappointing you by making promises I couldn't keep. It's my fault for not being more honest...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even back then, I kept wishing that I could hang out with you and the others more...

rows.Speaker: Ayumi
rows.Line: You did...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Neither of us really wanted to drift apart...
Our feelings toward each other never changed.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm so glad for you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You guys are the ones who gave me to courage to go talk to her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just as you still possess feelings for them, Airi, I'm sure they also still feel the same way about you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a hard time believing that such bonds would break so easily.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
The bonds forged between friends don't break so easily...
That gave me the push I needed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, KAITO, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll be wishing you and Ayumi the best as you catch back up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks! That's gonna start with us having lunch together again!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi... If it's okay with the both of you, would you mind introducing me to her?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh? Sure, I don't mind...
Wait, are you worried about how things are gonna go with us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I was just hoping to become friends with her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A friend of a friend is also my friend, no?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. True.
Then, I'll ask her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, sorry...
We didn't mean to exclude you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's okay. Don't mind me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's wonderful to see their circles of friends growing right before my eyes...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi...
Would it be alright if I asked you for a favor?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm all yours!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then...
If it's not too much trouble...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like it if you could tell me how your lunch with Ayumi goes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's all?
Of course!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you!
I'll be looking forward to hearing all about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Again, KAITO...
Thank you so much for what you did!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll keep watching over all of you from SEKAI moving forward, so please feel free to ask me for advice again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Airi
rows.Line: Thank you!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This seems like a good place to stop practice for today. Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Nice work☆
Nice work♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, we need to clean everything up and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Tsukasa and the others!
Welcome☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You all seem a bit down.
Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, we sort of need your help with something...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our help?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. And Nene's trying to fix her habits...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We've been trying to come up with ideas to help her...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But Nene's the most knowledgeable and experienced person in our troupe when it comes to singing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we don't know what the root cause of her problems is. As a result, we haven't been able to provide her with any usable advice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, what's Nene up to now...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She's practicing lots and lots...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But she seems to be struggling to make any progress.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wish we could spend more time thinking about this together, but we also have our own roles to think about since our practices have been steadily ramping up...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene even said that we should focus on practicing our own roles...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Only being able to watch from the sidelines is always tough...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But she helped me become Rio, so I'd like to pay her back somehow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Lately, Nene's been practicing her singing on her own.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been wanting to go talk to her, but she seemed to serious and focused...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
She must be feeling pretty lonely...
I know how you feel. I'd want to go over and talk to her too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you'd be getting in the way of her practicing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there a way to show our support for her without doing that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (A way to show Nene our support for her without interrupting her practices...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It'd be nice if we could also cheer everyone else up at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, that's it...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Everyone, how about a video?
We could make one and send it to Nene to show our support.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A video to show our support?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Nene would be able to watch it at her own leisure, which means we wouldn't have to bother her during practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, she could watch it as many times as she likes. It could serve as a source of hope whenever she feels lonely during or after practice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Tsukasa, Rui!
I wanna do that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me three♪
I wanna shout, “Let's go, Nene!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, let's gift her with all the cheers we can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That sounds wonderful♪
Oh, since all of us are here, we could make a show out of it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't we also invite the plushies to join us?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent idea!
She won't know what hit her when she watches this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ Let's put on an ultra-happy carnival show that makes Nene smile from ear to ear♪

rows.Speaker: Rin, Miku & Len
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That means we'll need to come up with a script.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, of course!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO, mind if we borrowed some props from the stage?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, then, the rest of us can go wrangle up the plushies☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, please go right ahead.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. They're already smiling quite a bit...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, I should also get to work.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone have their pom-poms ready?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yup! We're all set!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
We can dance too!
Look! I can spin round and round!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you're spinning so gracefully.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm glad we practiced that so much.
Let's go put on a show that Tsukasa and the others will really enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
And they should be arriving soon.
Why don't we move to the sides of the stage to hide?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? There appears to be no one here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's odd... We're supposed to have the after-party to celebrate our show today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did we get here too early or something?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't think we did—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, Emu, Nene, Rui♪
Welcome to the “Congratulations on a Wonderful Show” special performance!
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! You guys are gonna do a show for us?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! We've been practicing a ton just for today♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We hope you enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: We're in it too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: It's showtiiime!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: One, two♪ One, two, three, four♪

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Lalala-lala-lalala♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're in a chorus line! That's so cute...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
They're jumping as a line onto a trampoline now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember how we used it when we made that video for Nene? They've improved quite a bit since then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Tsukasa and the others aren't the only ones who've grown as performers.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, we're just getting started♪
Up we go☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! Miku jumped up so high!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Don't forget about us♪ Up we go!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO, we're up soon♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's go blow them away!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, that was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We even got to jump in partway through.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How can anyone sit still after seeing such a magnificent show?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, right♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I understand what you mean, but I was pretty startled when you asked us onto the stage after we made eye contact, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe♪ That made me really happy☆
And really glad since I thought it'd be super fun!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Please allow me to congratulate you again on a successful 30th Anniversary Show.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
Congrats!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for your support. I in particular had a very tough time with my role...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Same here...
I only did well because you guys were all behind me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The video you guys sent also helped a lot. It allowed me to keep going whenever I was about to give up...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It did...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know she really wants to become a better singer, but I wish I could help her more...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think you've helped her quite a bit already.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But Nene received a nice boost of encouragement from the video message we all sent her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which leads me to believe that she feels more motivated than ever to try her best.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure our support means quite a lot to her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Nene seems to have heard all of your cheers loud and clear, everyone.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that our show's finished, I believe it's time to start the actual party.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everything is all set up♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We'll take you guys over!
Let's GO GO GO☆
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: KAITO? Are you here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, um... Yes, I'm here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What are you still doing here? I thought practice ended...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We were hoping we could ask you about something!
It's about these!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are these tickets...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We have a design that we like for our flyers, but we're still undecided about our tickets...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because the designer for that can't seem to make up her mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hey, I've been having trouble because I keep getting all these great ideas!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, we couldn't come to a decision even after discussing it as a group... Then we went to ask Len for his opinion since he likes to draw, but he said...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You should ask KAITO. He's way better at this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: He's given me a lot of advice regarding layout and stuff for my drawings, so I'm sure he'll know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, KAITO, please...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to help that much...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But it is nice to hear that they want my advice...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I'll see what I can do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The ticket designs I came up with look something like this!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that's the natural reaction...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Give it to me straight! I can handle it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, then...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They're all a bit...in your face...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All these little drawings trying to tell me different things... And in so many bright colors. I'm having trouble understanding what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, I might've gone a little overboard there...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree... Especially this one that says, “Thank☆You☆All!!” in big letters across the middle...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's an obnoxious design.
I can hear Tsukasa shouting this, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sh-Shiho...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, it's clear from every ticket's design that you genuinely want the audience to enjoy your show...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, thank you!
That's what I was going for!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, actually, Saki...
Didn't you come up with some other designs?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, but just some I got stuck on and didn't end up finishing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like this one...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A starry sky...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's very simple compared to your other ones.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah... I started feeling kinda sad while drawing it, so I threw it in the reject pile.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
But I think the sky you made looks lovely.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I kinda like this design too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? It doesn't make you feel sad or anything?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I understand what you mean...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But at the same time...
I think it suits Leo/need very well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your songs have the power to encourage others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They tell your listeners that they're not alone and everything is going to be okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, I think this is a good design...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Then!
What would you do with what you see here?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me? Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You could have the Leo/need logo in the middle... And what if you added some shooting stars?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Just gimme one sec to...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: There. What's next?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As simple as it looks, I think this should do nicely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This tells your guests everything they need to know.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because our music is gonna do all the talking! You're a genius, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Umm...
That's not quite what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do the rest of you think? Is this okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I like it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! Then let's go with this♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Len was right.
I'm glad we decided to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Thank you very much, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Again, thank you so much!
We promise to show you the finished product once it's done!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be looking forward to seeing it...
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: KAITO, wait!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh. Hello, girls...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There's something we wanna give you!
Can you guess what♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki, you shouldn't tease KAITO like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you're not gonna tell him, we will.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, no! I wanna tell him!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ahem. Lemme start over...
KAITO, what we wanna give you is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa! A sample ticket for our show♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, the one we talked about...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup! And this one's special!
I laminated it so that it wouldn't get all crumpled!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's very nice of you, but are you sure I can have this...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, we want you to have it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It wouldn't have turned out so well if we hadn't asked you for advice, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What she said! If we'd decided on our own, we probably would've gone with my “Thank☆You☆All!!” design♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yikes... Then, I'm really glad we asked.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I actually kind of liked it since it was pretty unique.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it did a very good job of describing what kind of show everyone would be seeing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi...! Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There you two go again. Spoiling her...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, since you went to all this trouble, I'll happily accept this sample ticket...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! And thank you so much♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll see you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: See you tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm glad I could help them...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(Where should I keep this ticket...?
It's a bit too large to use as a bookmark...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Somewhere visible would be ideal...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wah...! Y-You scared me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry...
Um... Can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was hoping to ask you a favor...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sorry, I know this is very sudden...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, that's okay...
I don't mind if I'm just doing the accompaniment.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You want to play that song, yes...?
The one you're going to sing with Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was so surprised when Ichika first asked me to do this...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?
You want me to sing with you during your show...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want you to know what it's like...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not to feel like you're making a connection with us, but to actually do it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sing with me, Miku!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's very like Ichika to invite you in such an earnest manner.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed after remembering what happened...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I hope you enjoy that moment.
For all of us...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Of course.
Which means I'll need to practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Actually connecting with others...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Those starry-sky tickets are going out to everyone that will come to see the show...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Maybe that's also one type of connection...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, look! I just saw a shooting star...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even this SEKAI is giving you its support, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I sure hope so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll be counting on your accompaniment, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right.
Here we go...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're back.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome back, you three.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Did you all go somewhere...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We went over for a little bit to see how Kohane and the others were doing! But they looked busy, so we didn't try talking to them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They hadn't started practicing yet, but they sounded super motivated! The air almost felt electric!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I haven't seen them here for a while now, but it's good to hear that they're practicing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're all very diligent and hard-working, unlike you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, they really are a remarkable bunch.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still, I feel from time to time that they need to relax a little more...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But Miku's right in terms of their work ethic. I can't help but root for them...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It just goes to show how fun singing can be.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, KAITO's got something on his mind.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, he might be thinking seriously about something for a change.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Even KAITO has these sorts of moments...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But they're suuuper rare.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But what could he be thinking about?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, I've made my decision!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?! What decision?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I have a great idea!
Everyone, please listen!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! You want us to do an event?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! It'll be our way of showing Kohane and the others our support!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And we're going to sing their songs.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, us singing Vivid BAD SQUAD's songs...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! It'll give us an opportunity to create remixes of them and present new ways to sing them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And to show them new ways to have fun.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, how about it? Let's put on an event that'll really inspire them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds nice.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wonderful idea, KAITO!
Is this what you were thinking about just now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It was!
So, MEIKO, what do you think? Great idea, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just hope you're not planning something else, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? What makes you think that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because you're actively trying to get us to agree to your idea instead of waiting for us to respond on our own.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That tells me you have ulterior motives.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Ah, MEIKO's as sharp as ever.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I promise that I'm not planning anything else. I simply wish to demonstrate my support for Kohane and the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If there is anything else I'm thinking, it's just that it's going to be incredibly fun to put on an event together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree with you there.
I apologize for casting doubt on you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, that's okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Anyway!
Now that we're all in agreement, we need to start getting ready!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Starting with what?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll help you with whatever!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, that's rare. You seem awfully eager to help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because it sounds like a wonderful event♪ I want to be part of it from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, I feel the same way about wanting to show my support for them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Excellent.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, let's start going over what we'll need to do to prepare for this!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Great work, everyone!
Here's to a successful event!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & Luka
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kohane, An, Akito & Toya
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ahh...!
There's nothing better than iced coffee after an event!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's nothing better than this orange juice!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Or this cream soda♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've never seen anyone use cream soda for a toast. Also, I think you got some ice cream on your nose when you went to take a sip.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, you saw?
I was hoping no one would notice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you've all worked up quite an appetite. I have some sandwiches here if you'd like.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, I'd like some as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, relax.
There's plenty to go around, so have as many as you like.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! Thank you for these!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much for inviting us to today's event, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I should be thanking all of you for taking the time out of your busy schedules! I know you've been practicing very hard!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, did you enjoy being a part of it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think we learned a lot! I didn't realize that our songs can be sung in such different ways!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you did a good job with those remixes. I kinda want those files if they're available.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it was all so much fun!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Singing remixes of our own songs was such a new experience! Plus, it was fun to test out different techniques to see what works best!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I believe their relaxed style gave us some breathing room to think about how to sing them.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's pretty amazing how a song can feel totally different based on who sings it and how they interpret it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes! I hope we can try a lot of things out among ourselves!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, I'd be more than happy to teach you all what I know. Feel free to ask whenever.

rows.Speaker: An, Kohane, Akito & Toya
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They all look so excited...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I hope they never forget all the fun we had today.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll start getting refills.
Any requests?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
I'd like some iced coffee and a cream soda.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, for me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, for me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, you're getting two at once?
Then, I'd like a cream soda and a lemonade♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I'm gonna get two too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Settle down, everyone.
Don't make MEIKO work so hard.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll help if you'd like, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So will we.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's so kind of you two.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Says you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll start working on your refills, but you all need to bus your own glasses.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Okay!
Program Studio

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hey there, everyone! It's time to “Get on Those Hot Topics!”>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: It sure is! As you can see, today's special guest is VIRTUAL SINGER KAITO! Thank you for being here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you for having me.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: KAITO will be performing in the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show, scheduled to be held in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: And so! We have asked the folks in Shibuya about what comes to mind when they think of KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Wow, I guess we're jumping right into it. I'm a little nervous.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hehe. Now let's take a look at what people have said!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: What do I think about KAITO? I'd say he's the cool and kind older brother type!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: I'm the opposite. I find that KAITO is the kind to sing songs that end up making you laugh!

rows.Speaker: Passerby C
rows.Line: For me, his scarf immediately comes to mind. I personally like the way his scarf moves in his music videos or videos of him performing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I suppose that since I sing a variety of songs, people have a few different impressions of me.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: It appears so. But it seems like most people do think of you as an older brother figure or someone who takes care of others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Really? I wonder if people find me reliable. If so, that makes me happy.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: In addition, the people we interviewed also let us know their favorite songs of yours.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We did get quite a variety. However, it seems like your soulful ballads are the most popular.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: I think this could be a sign that it suits your calm and genuine voice, which are also your charming points.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hahaha. I'm blushing from all these compliments.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hehe. I'd now like to read out a message we received from one of our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
He's a third-year high school student.
“Despite being made captain, I injured myself during a game and have been feeling restless and afraid that I'll end up having to quit.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “But lately, I've been listening to KAITO's songs every day to ease my stress and working hard to eventually get back onto the field.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “He has this particular kind of voice that easily calms my nerves, and just listening to his songs makes me feel reassured.”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Reassured...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Thank you. I'm glad that I could be a source of support for you.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: All of you do possess voices with a very particular quality quite different from humans'.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: But I'm sure it's that same quality that means you're able to get certain emotions across that others cannot.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: I'm sure that is one of the reasons why creators are able to entrust their songs to VIRTUAL SINGERS to sing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If that's true, then there's nothing I could be prouder about.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Though we were able to discuss a lot, unfortunately that is all the time we have.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: KAITO, is there anything about the show you'd like our viewers to keep an eye out for?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <In order to deliver as many songs as we can to everyone, we will be performing many medleys in this show.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Certain songs that we usually perform solo will be performed as duets or ensembles, making it a special kind of show.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We are also thinking of some interesting things to do between songs, so I hope you all look forward to it.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you very much, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We are still accepting messages for the VIRTUAL SINGERS!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: The messages will be displayed on a screen at the exhibition being held next to the show venue! Please do check them out if you plan to visit!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Thank you again for having me today!
I'll see you all at the show!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Host
rows.Line:
<Bye!>
Bye!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: All together now!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Once again, thank you for coming to the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We're approaching the end of today's show, but are you all having fun?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, looks like they are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm glad. And it seems like you're all still full of energy yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I've still got a lot left in me!
I bet I could do ten more shows after this!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Ten? That's a lot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think I understand where Len's coming from.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We've performed more songs than we usually do in today's show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But even so, there are still a lot more songs that I want everyone to hear.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You said it! There were so many other songs I wanted to put in our set list!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But if we sang all of them, then the show would take a really long time...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: When we first put down all of the songs we wanted to sing, we ended up with a list that would take longer than a day to sing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha, that's right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even so, we still wanted to sing as many of them as we could, which is why we went for the medley approach.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If there were any songs in our medleys today that you didn't know before or that got you curious, we'd love for you all to listen to their original versions.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hold on, you wouldn't know the title of a song you didn't know, right? How is everyone going to find them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That is an excellent question, Len.
We have actually prepared for this, right, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please check out the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show website after the show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Today's set list and links to the original versions of each song will be on there.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Awesome!
That means you can check out any of the songs that piqued your interest with a simple click!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right! Please do make use of the website.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Being able to stand on stage like this and getting to hear all of your cheers fills me with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There are so many creators who let us sing their songs, so many that we can't fit them in one show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And on top of that, there are so many others coming to watch us perform.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We have not only people right here with us, but also people watching the livestream and attending remote screenings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's right. Right at this very moment, we are connected to people all around the world through music.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm going to continue singing each and every song with everything I have. For both the creators and everyone who listens to us.

rows.Speaker: Luka & Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright! Now let's do our best until the very end!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Are you ready, everyone?
Let's do it!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO!
Are you going somewhere?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No, I'm just heading over to the stage.

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
The stage?
Even though there aren't any shows?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. I have some things to take care of.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There we go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
These should be all of the props.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even so, they sure have increased.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (At the beginning we had a lot more props for magic tricks and whatnot as opposed to stage props.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But once Len and the others came and started joining our shows, the scale of them just got bigger and bigger.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Before I knew it, we had a mountain's worth of props.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We really did so many kinds of shows...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well then, I better get started.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah! It's just like the plushies said!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Even though we don't have any shows today, what are you doing here, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, this? I'm doing an inspection of our props.

rows.Speaker: Len, Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Inspection?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, like checking if the props aren't broken and stuff after a show is done?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whenever we're preparing for a show, I always make sure to take a proper look at the props we use for that specific show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I figured I would check through all of them today.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: All of them?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But KAITO, there are boxes and boxes filled with props!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha... I know. I was just thinking about how much they have increased.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Regardless, I'd like to check them while I have the time.
Especially since I'd like to get this done before Tsukasa and the others start freelancing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others have always had the Wonder Stage to use for practice, but now they won't be able to use it anymore.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I was hoping to let them use this stage and these props as a replacement.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good thinking, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's so kind of you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're a troupe leader!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Miku, I don't think “troupe leader” comes off as a compliment.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I have an idea. If you don't mind, would you please help check these props?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Like I mentioned before, there are a lot more than I expected... I don't think I'll be able to get through all of these on my own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay☆ I'll help you♪

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line:
Me too♪
Me three!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you. Well then, let's get—
So we overheard your conversation!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Is that...MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, Luka, when did you two get here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We were here the whole time♪
I was taking a nap with Luka in the green room.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then I started hearing some clanking noises and when I went to see what it was, I saw you taking out the props, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After that, I went to wake her up and ended up overhearing your conversation!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO. We'd like to help out as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! I feel much more refreshed and energetic after that nap♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehehe. Refreshed... And energetic...
*Yawn*

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for offering, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, what to do today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
